_spec.purpose: 多益 Part 4 簡短獨白題庫；一組＝一段獨白＋3題四選一

easy.guide: 單一主題、6–8 句、答案幾乎照字面出現、無圖表

medium.guide: 8–10 句、同義換句、有 but／however 轉折、至少 1 題推論或意圖

hard.guide: 10–14 句、先說 A 再更正為 B、含圖表題或意圖題、資訊密集

qtypes.main: 主旨／目的／問題／職業／地點
qtypes.intent: 意圖（題目引用對話中一句話）
qtypes.graphic: 圖表題，題目以 Look at the graphic 開頭，須有 graphic
qtypes.who: 身份（說話者或聽眾是誰）

_spec.entry_schema: {id:d{1-7}-{3位數}-{e|m|h}, domain, scene, mtype(須在 mtypes 內), tag(中文,不重複), form:'talk', level:{score,cefr,tier,why}, speakers:[單一{id:'S',gender:'F'|'M',role}], script:[{t,zh}], graphic:null|{title,columns:[],rows:[[]]}, questions:[{id:'q1',qtype,q:{t,zh},choices:剛好4個{t,zh,ok,trap(錯誤句,取自traps)|pattern(正解:direct|paraphrase|summary),why}, evidence:[script句索引從0起,遞增]}] 共3題, vocab:[2–4個{word,ipa,pos,col,zh}]}

rules.choices: 每題 4 選項、剛好 1 正解；正解盡量用同義替換，不照抄對話原字；錯誤選項需有明確對話依據可排除。
rules.order: 3 題的 evidence 依題號遞增。
rules.output: 輸出單一合法 JSON 陣列（UTF-8、不加程式碼區塊標記）。
rules.script: 單一說話者獨白（沒有對話）；每句 5–25 字，口語自然、符合 mtype 的開場與結尾慣例；初級 6–8 句、中級 8–10 句、高級 10–14 句。
rules.graphic: 圖表題以 Look at the graphic 開頭，答案須結合圖表與獨白（獨白更正圖表上的資訊，或需用兩個條件對照）。
rules.intent: 意圖題的引號句必須逐字出現在 script 中。

level.why: 單一主題的公司公告，答案幾乎照字面出現。

script.t: Good morning, everyone. This is an announcement from the Human Resources department.
script.zh: 大家早安。這是人資部門的公告。

script.t: Starting next Monday, all employees will need a new photo badge to enter the building.
script.zh: 從下週一起，所有員工都需要新的照片識別證才能進入大樓。

script.t: The old cards will stop working at nine a.m. that day.
script.zh: 舊卡片當天上午九點就會失效。

script.t: To get your new badge, please visit the security desk in the main lobby.
script.zh: 要領取新識別證，請到大廳的警衛櫃檯。

script.t: The desk is open from eight to five, Monday through Friday.
script.zh: 櫃檯週一到週五的八點到五點開放。

script.t: Please bring your old card and a photo ID with you.
script.zh: 請帶著舊卡片和一張附照片的身分證件。

script.t: If you have any questions, contact Ms. Lopez at extension 204. Thank you.
script.zh: 如有任何問題，請撥分機 204 聯絡 Lopez 女士。謝謝。

q.t: Who is the announcement intended for?
q.zh: 這則公告是對誰說的？

choices.why: 公告對象是 all employees，不是訪客。
正解：all employees → company employees。
警衛櫃檯只是領證地點。
完全沒有提到應徵。

q.t: What will happen next Monday?
q.zh: 下週一會發生什麼事？

choices.why: 大廳只是領取識別證的地點。
八點到五點是櫃檯服務時間。

choices.zh: 員工需要新的身分識別。
choices.why: 正解：new photo badge → new identification。
沒有提到新辦公室。

q.t: What are listeners asked to do?
q.zh: 聽眾被要求做什麼？

choices.zh: 打電話給 Lopez 女士
choices.why: 有問題才聯絡她，不是領證步驟。
只說要帶舊卡片去櫃檯。
八點是櫃檯開放時間。

choices.t: Pick up a badge in the lobby
choices.why: 正解：visit the security desk in the main lobby → pick up a badge in the lobby。

level.why: 會議摘錄，講者更正圖表日期，需結合圖表與獨白作答，並含意圖題。

script.t: Good morning, everyone, and thanks for coming to this month's staff meeting.
script.zh: 大家早安，感謝各位參加本月的員工會議。

script.t: I'd like to begin with an update on our upcoming move to the new building.
script.zh: 我想先報告即將搬到新大樓的最新進度。

script.t: As you can see on the schedule, each department has a floor and a move date.
script.zh: 如您在時程表上所見，每個部門都有樓層和搬遷日期。

script.t: However, one date has changed since this schedule was printed.
script.zh: 不過，這份時程表印出之後，有一個日期已經更動。

script.t: The elevator inspection in the new building is on March 11, so Accounting will move on March 14 instead.
script.zh: 新大樓的電梯檢查在 3 月 11 日，所以會計部改在 3 月 14 日搬遷。

script.t: Sales, Marketing, and Design will keep their original dates.
script.zh: 業務部、行銷部和設計部會維持原定日期。

script.t: Please pack your personal items in the boxes that the facilities team will deliver on Friday.
script.zh: 請把您的私人物品裝進設施組星期五會送來的箱子裡。

script.t: Computers will be moved by the IT team, so please don't unplug anything yourselves.
script.zh: 電腦會由資訊組搬運，所以請不要自己拔掉任何東西。

script.t: If you have questions about your new floor, speak to Ms. Rivera after the meeting.
script.zh: 如果您對新樓層有疑問，會後請找里維拉女士。

script.t: Now, let's move on to the budget report.
script.zh: 現在，我們來看預算報告。

q.t: What is the main topic of the talk?
q.zh: 這段談話的主題是什麼？

choices.why: 預算報告是會議接下來的議程，不是這段的主題。

choices.zh: 即將到來的辦公室搬遷
choices.why: 正解：update on our upcoming move to the new building。
全文沒有提到新進員工。
只提到電梯檢查，而且只是更改日期的原因。

q.t: Look at the graphic. On which floor will the department with the changed date work?
q.zh: 請看圖表。日期有更動的部門將在哪一層樓工作？

choices.why: 三樓是業務部，日期沒有更動。
五樓是行銷部與設計部，日期維持不變。
圖表上沒有六樓。
正解：獨白說會計部改期，圖表上會計部在四樓。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "please don't unplug anything yourselves"?
q.zh: 講者為什麼說「請不要自己拔掉任何東西」？

choices.t: To ask employees to move computers themselves
choices.why: 意思相反，電腦由資訊組搬運。

choices.t: To warn that the power will be turned off
choices.why: 對話沒有提到停電。

choices.t: To let the IT team handle the equipment
choices.why: 正解：Computers will be moved by the IT team。
沒有提到電費或節能。

level.why: 公告先說原定時程再更正兩處錯誤，需對照圖表判斷哪一場改教室。

script.t: Attention, all employees. This is a brief announcement from the IT department about next week's expense system training.
script.zh: 各位員工請注意。這是資訊部門關於下週報銷系統訓練的簡短公告。

script.t: Each department has been assigned a session, and the full schedule was emailed to everyone on Friday.
script.zh: 每個部門都被分配到一場訓練，完整時程表星期五已寄給所有人。

script.t: Unfortunately, that schedule contains two mistakes, so please read this carefully before you plan your week.
script.zh: 很遺憾，那份時程表有兩處錯誤，所以請在安排下週行程前仔細聽。

script.t: First, the Wednesday session was listed in Room 204, but that room will be repainted on Wednesday.
script.zh: 第一，星期三的訓練原本列在 204 室，但那間教室星期三要粉刷。

script.t: That session will instead take place in Room 310, which is on the same floor as the cafeteria.
script.zh: 那場訓練將改在 310 室，就在自助餐廳同一層樓。

script.t: Second, the Thursday session was listed for 2:00 P.M., but the trainer can only arrive at 3:30 in the afternoon.
script.zh: 第二，星期四的訓練原本列在下午兩點，但講師最早下午三點半才能到。

script.t: Thursday's group will therefore start at 3:30, and the session will still end at 5:00 as planned.
script.zh: 因此星期四的小組將在三點半開始，並照原訂計畫在五點結束。

script.t: All other sessions will run exactly as shown on the schedule.
script.zh: 其他所有場次都會完全照時程表進行。

script.t: Please bring your company laptop and your login information, since you will practice submitting real reports.
script.zh: 請攜帶公司筆電和登入資訊，因為你們會練習提交真實的報告。

script.t: If you cannot attend your assigned session, contact Ms. Duran in the IT department by Friday.
script.zh: 如果您無法參加被分配的場次，請在星期五前聯絡資訊部門的杜蘭女士。

script.t: She can move you to another group, but only if there is an open seat.
script.zh: 她可以幫您換到別組，但前提是有空位。

script.t: Thank you for your attention, and have a productive week.
script.zh: 感謝您的注意，祝您有個有成效的一週。

q.t: What is the purpose of the announcement?
q.zh: 這則公告的目的是什麼？

choices.t: To introduce a new expense system
choices.why: 報銷系統只是訓練主題，公告重點是更正時程。
其他場次照常進行，只有兩處更動。

choices.t: To correct errors in a training schedule
choices.zh: 更正訓練時程中的錯誤
choices.why: 正解：that schedule contains two mistakes。

choices.t: To ask for volunteers to lead sessions
choices.why: 全文沒有徵求志願者。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which department's session will be held in a different room?
q.zh: 請看圖表。哪個部門的訓練將改到別的教室？

choices.why: 業務部在 118 室，沒有更動。
310 室是會計部星期二的教室，星期三才是借用 310 室的場次。
正解：星期三原列 204 室，改到 310 室；圖表上星期三是行銷部。
設計部更動的是開始時間，不是教室。

q.t: What are employees who cannot attend asked to do?
q.zh: 無法參加的員工被要求做什麼？

choices.t: Call the IT department on Thursday
choices.zh: 星期四打電話給資訊部門
choices.why: 星期四是某場訓練的日期，聯絡期限是星期五。
要聯絡的是資訊部門的杜蘭女士，不是講師。

choices.t: Notify an IT staff member by Friday
choices.zh: 在星期五前通知一位資訊部同仁
choices.why: 正解：contact Ms. Duran in the IT department by Friday。
沒有提到會再寄郵件。

level.why: 電話留言單一主題，會議室與時間照字面出現。

script.t: Good afternoon, Ms. Park. This is Daniel Wu from the Finance office.
script.zh: Park 小姐午安，我是財務部的 Daniel Wu。

script.t: I am calling about Monday's budget meeting.
script.zh: 我來電是關於週一的預算會議。

script.t: We have moved it from Room 301 to Room 205 on the second floor.
script.zh: 我們已把會議從 301 室改到二樓的 205 室。

script.t: The projector in Room 301 is broken, and the repair will take until Tuesday.
script.zh: 301 室的投影機壞了，維修要到週二才會完成。

script.t: The meeting will still start at ten a.m.
script.zh: 會議仍然在上午十點開始。

script.t: Please bring a printed copy of your department report.
script.zh: 請帶一份您部門報告的列印本。

script.t: If you have any questions, call me at extension 4120.
script.zh: 如果有任何問題，請撥分機 4120 找我。

script.t: Thank you, and have a nice day.
script.zh: 謝謝您，祝您有愉快的一天。

q.t: Why is the speaker calling?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼來電？

choices.t: To tell Ms. Park about a new meeting room
choices.zh: 告知 Park 小姐新的會議室
choices.why: 正解：moved it from Room 301 to Room 205。

choices.t: To ask for a repair of the projector
choices.why: 投影機故障只是換房間的原因。
會議照常舉行，只是換地點。
會議仍在上午十點開始。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "The projector in Room 301 is broken, and the repair will take until Tuesday."?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼說「The projector in Room 301 is broken, and the repair will take until Tuesday.」？

choices.t: To explain why the room was changed
choices.why: 正解：前一句換房間，這句說明原因。

choices.t: To ask Ms. Park to fix it
choices.why: 沒有要求她修理。
週二只是維修完成的時間。

choices.t: To report a problem in Room 205
choices.why: 壞掉的是 301 室。

q.t: What can be inferred about Ms. Park?
q.zh: 關於 Park 小姐可以推論什麼？

choices.t: She is expected to attend the meeting.
choices.why: 正解：請她帶部門報告，表示她要參加。

choices.t: She works in the Finance office.
choices.why: 財務部是說話者的部門，她有自己的部門。
沒有提到她修過投影機。

choices.t: She will give a talk on Tuesday.
choices.why: 週二只與維修有關。

level.why: 電話留言，含 however 轉折與替代方案，需用同義換句判斷意圖。

script.t: Hello, Ms. Alvarez. This is Kevin from the IT help desk, returning your call.
script.zh: 您好，阿爾瓦雷斯女士。我是資訊服務台的凱文，回覆您的來電。

script.t: You asked about upgrading your laptop to the newer model that your team received.
script.zh: 您詢問要把筆電升級成貴團隊拿到的新機型。

script.t: I'm sorry to say that the model you requested is currently out of stock.
script.zh: 很抱歉，您要的那款目前缺貨。

script.t: However, we do have a similar one with a larger screen and the same battery life.
script.zh: 不過，我們有一款類似的，螢幕比較大，電池續航力相同。

script.t: The only difference is that it's slightly heavier, so it may be less convenient for travel.
script.zh: 唯一的差別是它稍微重一點，所以出差時可能比較不方便。

script.t: Your manager has already approved the budget, so the price won't be a problem.
script.zh: 您的主管已經核准預算，所以價格不會是問題。

script.t: If you'd like the larger model, please call me back at 555-0132 before Thursday noon.
script.zh: 如果您想要較大的機型，請在星期四中午前回電 555-0132。

script.t: Otherwise, I'll put your name on the waiting list for the original model, which could take two weeks.
script.zh: 否則我會把您排進原機型的候補名單，可能要兩週。

script.t: Thanks, and talk to you soon.
script.zh: 謝謝，再聯絡。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 核准預算的是女士的主管，不是說話者。
沒有提到送貨。
他在公司內部資訊服務台工作，不是店員。
正解：from the IT help desk。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "it's slightly heavier"?
q.zh: 講者為什麼說「它稍微重一點」？

choices.why: 他說價格不是問題。
正解：重一點，所以出差可能比較不方便。

choices.t: To explain why the original is unavailable
choices.zh: 解釋為什麼原機型買不到
choices.why: 缺貨的原因沒有說明，而且重的是替代機型。
替代機型沒有提到品牌差異。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Ms. Alvarez to do?
q.zh: 說話者請阿爾瓦雷斯女士做什麼？

choices.why: 主管已經核准了預算。

choices.t: Pick up a laptop on Thursday
choices.why: 星期四是回電期限，不是領取日期。

choices.t: Let him know if she wants the larger model
choices.zh: 若想要較大機型就通知他
choices.why: 正解：If you'd like the larger model, please call me back。

choices.t: Wait two weeks for a new model
choices.why: 兩週是原機型候補的時間，不是要她做的事。

level.why: 廣告先說傳單日期再更正，並含多項數字條件與意圖題。

script.t: Is your office still struggling with slow printers and wobbly chairs? Then Delta Office Supply has great news for you.
script.zh: 你的辦公室還在為老舊的印表機和搖晃的椅子所苦嗎？那麼德爾塔辦公用品有好消息要告訴你。

script.t: This week only, small businesses and office managers can save thirty percent on all desks, chairs, and storage cabinets.
script.zh: 僅限本週，小型企業和辦公室管理者所有辦公桌、椅子和收納櫃都可省三成。

script.t: Our flyer said the sale would end this Sunday, but that was a mistake on our part.
script.zh: 我們的傳單說特賣到本週日結束，但那是我們的錯誤。

script.t: The sale will actually continue through next Wednesday, so you have extra time to visit.
script.zh: 特賣其實會持續到下週三，所以你有更多時間來逛逛。

script.t: In addition, every order over two hundred dollars will qualify for free delivery within the city.
script.zh: 此外，每筆超過兩百美元的訂單都可享市區免運。

script.t: The flyer also listed printer paper at half price, but that offer is limited to the first fifty customers each day.
script.zh: 傳單也列出影印紙半價，但這項優惠僅限每天前五十位顧客。

script.t: If you're setting up a brand-new workspace, ask about our furniture planning service, which costs nothing with any purchase.
script.zh: 如果你正在布置全新的工作空間，歡迎詢問我們的家具規劃服務，任何消費都免費。

script.t: Our designers will measure your space and recommend a layout that fits your budget.
script.zh: 我們的設計師會丈量你的空間，並建議符合預算的配置。

script.t: Remember, orders placed online receive the same discounts as those made in our stores.
script.zh: 請記得，線上下單與店內購買享有相同折扣。

script.t: Visit us on Maple Street, or browse our entire catalog online.
script.zh: 歡迎蒞臨楓樹街門市，或上網瀏覽我們完整的型錄。

script.t: Delta Office Supply, everything your workplace needs, all in one place.
script.zh: 德爾塔辦公用品，您的職場所需，一站購足。

q.t: Who is the advertisement intended for?
q.zh: 這則廣告是針對誰？

choices.why: 免運只是優惠之一，聽眾不是司機。
沒有提到學生。
設計師是商店提供規劃服務的人員，不是聽眾。
正解：small businesses and office managers。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "that was a mistake on our part"?
q.zh: 講者為什麼說「那是我們的錯誤」？

choices.t: To apologize for a delivery delay
choices.why: 沒有提到送貨延遲。

choices.t: To correct the end date on a flyer
choices.zh: 更正傳單上的結束日期
choices.why: 正解：傳單寫週日結束，實際持續到下週三。

choices.t: To warn that prices will rise
choices.why: 講者是延長特賣，不是漲價。
全文沒有提到召回。

q.t: What does the speaker say about the printer paper offer?
q.zh: 關於影印紙優惠，講者說了什麼？

choices.zh: 需要訂單超過兩百美元。
choices.why: 兩百美元是免運門檻，不是影印紙條件。
線上與店內折扣相同，沒有限定線上。
下週三是整體特賣的新期限，影印紙另有名額限制。

choices.t: It is limited to a certain number of shoppers daily.
choices.zh: 每天限定一定人數的顧客。
choices.why: 正解：limited to the first fifty customers each day。

level.why: 導覽內容依樓層順序，地點與下一步直接提到。

script.t: Hi, everyone, and congratulations on your first day!
script.zh: 大家好，恭喜各位第一天上班！

script.t: I am Rachel from Human Resources, and I will show you around the office today.
script.zh: 我是人資部的 Rachel，今天由我帶大家參觀辦公室。

script.t: We are standing in the lobby, where visitors sign in at the front desk.
script.zh: 我們現在站在大廳，訪客會在櫃檯簽到。

script.t: Please follow me to the second floor, where the sales team works.
script.zh: 請跟我到二樓，業務團隊在那裡工作。

script.t: The break room is next to the elevator, and free coffee is available all day.
script.zh: 休息室在電梯旁邊，整天都有免費咖啡。

script.t: Your desks are on the third floor, near the large window.
script.zh: 各位的座位在三樓，靠近大窗戶。

script.t: After the tour, please return to the lobby to pick up your laptops.
script.zh: 導覽結束後，請回到大廳領取筆記型電腦。

script.t: Now, if you are ready, please watch your step and follow me.
script.zh: 現在，如果大家準備好了，請小心腳步並跟我來。

q.t: What is the purpose of the talk?
q.zh: 這段談話的目的是什麼？

choices.t: To show new employees around the office
choices.zh: 帶新進員工參觀辦公室
choices.why: 正解：first day / show you around the office。
聽眾是第一天上班的員工。
沒有提到搬遷。
沒有提到假期。

q.t: Where are the new employees' desks?
q.zh: 新進員工的座位在哪裡？

choices.why: 正解：Your desks are on the third floor。
大廳是訪客簽到與領筆電的地方。
二樓是業務團隊的位置。
電梯旁是休息室。

q.t: What will the listeners do after the tour?
q.zh: 聽眾在導覽後要做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：pick up your laptops → Collect。

choices.t: Sign in at the front desk
choices.why: 簽到的是訪客。
業務團隊只是參觀地點。

choices.t: Have free coffee in the break room
choices.why: 咖啡是介紹設施，不是導覽後的行動。

level.why: 退休致詞，含 but／however 轉折，需由事蹟推論人物特質。

script.t: Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining us for this special occasion.
script.zh: 各位午安，感謝大家參加這個特別的場合。

script.t: Today we say goodbye to Helen Park, who is retiring after twenty-five years in our finance department.
script.zh: 今天我們要向海倫・朴道別，她在財務部服務二十五年後即將退休。

script.t: Helen started as a junior clerk, but she soon became the person everyone turned to for advice.
script.zh: 海倫一開始是資淺的職員，但很快就成為大家請教的對象。

script.t: She trained more than forty new employees, and many of them are here today.
script.zh: 她訓練過四十多位新進員工，其中許多人今天也在場。

script.t: Last year, she led the project that cut our paperwork by half.
script.zh: 去年，她領導的專案讓我們的文書作業減少了一半。

script.t: However, what I'll remember most is her patience and her sense of humor.
script.zh: 不過，我最難忘的是她的耐心和幽默感。

script.t: Helen told us she plans to spend more time traveling, starting with a trip to Spain next month.
script.zh: 海倫告訴我們她打算多花時間旅行，下個月先去西班牙。

script.t: We will certainly miss her, but we wish her all the best.
script.zh: 我們一定會想念她，但也祝福她一切順利。

script.t: Now, please raise your glasses and join me in a toast to Helen.
script.zh: 現在，請大家舉杯，和我一起向海倫敬酒。

q.t: What is the purpose of the speech?
q.zh: 這段演講的目的是什麼？

choices.t: To announce a new department head
choices.why: 沒有提到接任者。
訓練新人只是海倫的事蹟之一。

choices.t: To report on last year's results
choices.why: 去年的專案只是舉例，不是目的。

choices.zh: 向即將退休的員工致敬
choices.why: 正解：Today we say goodbye to Helen Park, who is retiring。

q.t: What can be inferred about Helen?
q.zh: 關於海倫可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: She plans to start a new business.
choices.why: 她只說要旅行。

choices.t: She was hired as a manager.
choices.why: 她一開始是資淺職員，與此相反。

choices.t: She is well respected by her coworkers.
choices.why: 正解：大家都找她請教，且許多她訓練過的人到場。
她正在退休並計畫旅行，與此相反。

q.t: What will the listeners most likely do next?
q.zh: 聽眾接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.why: 沒有提到影片。
去西班牙的是海倫，不是聽眾。
沒有提到卡片。
正解：raise your glasses and join me in a toast。

level.why: 新聞先報導全體參加再更正為兩個團隊，資訊密集，需靠推論與意圖作答。

script.t: In business news this morning, Harlow Insurance announced a six-month trial of a four-day workweek at its downtown headquarters.
script.zh: 今早的商業新聞：哈洛保險宣布在市中心總部試行為期六個月的四天工作週。

script.t: Earlier reports suggested that all four hundred employees would take part, but the company clarified that only the claims and billing teams are included.
script.zh: 稍早報導指出全部四百名員工都會參加，但公司澄清只有理賠和帳務兩個團隊參加。

script.t: Those two teams, about ninety people in total, will work Monday through Thursday beginning on June first.
script.zh: 這兩個團隊共約九十人，從六月一日起週一到週四上班。

script.t: Their pay and benefits will not change, and each workday will be an hour longer.
script.zh: 他們的薪資和福利不變，而每天的工時會延長一小時。

script.t: The chief executive said the goal is to reduce burnout, because tired employees rarely serve customers well.
script.zh: 執行長表示目標是減少職業倦怠，因為疲憊的員工很少能把客戶服務好。

script.t: However, she stressed that customer service levels must stay the same, and phone lines will remain open on Fridays.
script.zh: 不過她強調客戶服務水準必須維持不變，週五電話專線仍會開放。

script.t: To make that possible, a small group of volunteers from other departments will answer calls on a rotating basis.
script.zh: 為了做到這點，其他部門的一小群志願者會輪流接聽電話。

script.t: Employees outside the trial have mixed reactions, with some saying they hope the program will be expanded.
script.zh: 試行範圍以外的員工反應不一，有些人說希望這項計畫擴大實施。

script.t: Others worry that the extra workload will fall on them.
script.zh: 也有人擔心額外的工作量會落到他們身上。

script.t: The company plans to survey everyone in November and then decide whether to continue the program.
script.zh: 公司計畫十一月調查所有人，再決定是否繼續這項計畫。

script.t: We'll have more on this story in our afternoon report.
script.zh: 這則新聞的更多內容，我們會在下午的報導中提供。

q.t: According to the report, who will take part in the trial?
q.zh: 根據報導，誰會參加這項試行？

choices.why: 這是稍早的報導，公司已更正。
志願者只是輪流接電話，不是試行對象。
沒有提到主管參加試行。
正解：only the claims and billing teams are included。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "tired employees rarely serve customers well"?
q.zh: 講者為什麼說「疲憊的員工很少能把客戶服務好」？

choices.t: To explain how the trial could help customers
choices.zh: 說明試行如何可能對客戶有幫助
choices.why: 正解：減少倦怠是目標，因為疲憊影響服務。
執行長是在說明試行原因，沒有批評現況。

choices.t: To say the trial may harm customers
choices.zh: 表示試行可能傷害客戶
choices.why: 意思相反，試行是為了改善服務。

choices.t: To announce plans to hire more staff
choices.why: 沒有提到招募。

q.t: What is implied about the employees in the trial?
q.zh: 關於參加試行的員工，暗示了什麼？

choices.why: 薪資和福利不變。

choices.zh: 他們每天上班時間會縮短。
choices.why: 每天會多一小時，與此相反。

choices.t: They will move to a new building.
choices.why: 沒有提到搬遷。

choices.t: They will not work on Fridays.
choices.why: 正解：週一到週四上班，週五由其他部門志願者接電話。

items.tag: 晚餐點餐時間提前截止

level.why: 餐廳廣播單一主題，時間與原因幾乎照字面出現。

script.t: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome to Sunset Bistro.
script.zh: 各位女士先生晚安，歡迎光臨 Sunset Bistro。

script.t: May I have your attention for a short announcement about tonight's dinner service?
script.zh: 請各位留意一下，我要簡短宣布今晚的晚餐供餐事項。

script.t: Our kitchen will stop taking orders at nine thirty instead of ten o'clock.
script.zh: 我們的廚房將在九點半停止接單，而不是十點。

script.t: We are getting ready for a large wedding party that will arrive early tomorrow morning.
script.zh: 我們正在為明天一早抵達的大型婚宴團體做準備。

script.t: If you would like dessert or a main dish, please place your order before nine thirty.
script.zh: 如果您想點甜點或主餐，請在九點半前下單。

script.t: Drinks and coffee will still be served until closing time.
script.zh: 飲料和咖啡仍會供應到打烊時間。

script.t: Please ask any of our servers if you need help with the menu.
script.zh: 如果您需要菜單方面的協助，請隨時詢問我們的服務生。

script.t: Thank you for dining with us, and enjoy the rest of your evening.
script.zh: 感謝您蒞臨用餐，祝您今晚愉快。

q.t: What is the purpose of the announcement?
q.zh: 這則廣播的目的是什麼？

choices.t: To change the time for taking orders
choices.why: 正解：九點半停止接單，而不是十點。

choices.t: To introduce a new dessert menu
choices.why: 甜點只在要求客人提早點餐時提到。

choices.t: To invite guests to a wedding
choices.why: 婚宴只是廚房提早準備的原因。
全文沒有道歉或提到出餐很慢。

q.t: Why will the kitchen stop taking orders early?
q.zh: 廚房為什麼要提早停止接單？

choices.t: It is preparing for a large event.
choices.zh: 正在為大型活動做準備。
choices.why: 正解：wedding party → large event；為明早的婚宴團體做準備。

choices.t: Some workers are in a training session.
choices.why: 全文沒有提到員工訓練。

choices.t: The restaurant has run out of food.
choices.why: 沒有提到食材不足，飲料與咖啡仍供應。

choices.t: The restaurant will close at ten o'clock.
choices.why: 十點是原本的停止接單時間，不是原因。

q.t: What does the speaker ask the guests to do?
q.zh: 說話者請客人做什麼？

choices.t: Order their food before nine thirty
choices.why: 正解：please place your order before nine thirty。

choices.t: Pay their bills at the counter
choices.why: 沒有提到結帳方式。
飲料與咖啡仍供應到打烊，並沒有要客人離開。

choices.t: Order their drinks before ten o'clock
choices.why: 飲料供應到打烊；十點是舊的接單時間。

level.why: 電話留言含轉折與兩個方案，需同義換句與推論。

script.t: Hello, Ms. Chen. This is Paul calling from Harbor Grill about your reservation.
script.zh: 陳小姐您好，我是 Harbor Grill 的 Paul，來電是關於您的訂位。

script.t: I know you booked a table for twelve this Saturday at six p.m. for your company dinner.
script.zh: 我知道您訂了這週六下午六點十二人的位子，要辦公司聚餐。

script.t: Unfortunately, our private room will be closed that evening because of a plumbing problem.
script.zh: 很抱歉，由於水管問題，我們的包廂那晚會關閉。

script.t: However, we can seat your group on the terrace, which has a lovely view of the harbor.
script.zh: 不過，我們可以讓您的團體坐在露臺，那裡能看到美麗的港景。

script.t: The weather forecast says it might be cool, so we will provide heaters at no extra charge.
script.zh: 氣象預報說可能偏涼，所以我們會免費提供暖爐。

script.t: If you would prefer to keep the private room, we could move your dinner to Sunday at the same time.
script.zh: 如果您希望保留包廂，我們可以把聚餐改到週日同一時間。

script.t: Please call me back at 555-0148 before noon tomorrow so I can hold either option for you.
script.zh: 請在明天中午前回電 555-0148，我才能為您保留任一方案。

script.t: I will be in the restaurant until ten tonight, and after nine tomorrow morning.
script.zh: 我今晚會在餐廳到十點，明天早上九點之後也在。

script.t: Thank you, and we look forward to serving you.
script.zh: 謝謝您，期待為您服務。

q.t: Why is the speaker calling?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼來電？

choices.why: 水管問題只是包廂關閉的原因。

choices.t: To offer alternatives for a booking
choices.why: 正解：露臺或改到週日，是在處理訂位問題。
沒有提到菜單。

choices.t: To ask for a larger deposit
choices.why: 沒有提到訂金。

q.t: What can be inferred about the terrace?
q.zh: 關於露臺可以推論出什麼？

choices.why: 因水管問題關閉的是包廂。

choices.t: It may be chilly in the evening.
choices.why: 正解：might be cool → may be chilly；因此提供暖爐。

choices.t: It is smaller than the private room.
choices.why: 沒有比較大小。

choices.t: It is open only on Sundays.
choices.why: 週日是另一個聚餐日期選項。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Ms. Chen to do by noon tomorrow?
q.zh: 說話者請陳小姐在明天中午前做什麼？

choices.why: 沒有要求付款。
正解：call me back → return his call。
他說自己會在餐廳，並非要她過去。
沒有提到名單。

items.tag: 週日早午餐價格與時間更正

level.why: 廣告資訊密集，傳單上的價格、時間與人數被更正，需對照圖表作答。

script.t: This fall, your Sunday mornings just got a lot more delicious at Lantern House.
script.zh: 今年秋天，Lantern House 讓您的週日早晨變得更加美味。

script.t: Starting October fourth, we are serving a full brunch every Sunday on our new garden patio.
script.zh: 從十月四日起，每週日我們在新的花園露台供應完整早午餐。

script.t: Our chef has built the menu around eggs, fresh bread, and seasonal fruit from nearby orchards.
script.zh: 主廚以雞蛋、新鮮麵包與鄰近果園的當季水果設計了這份菜單。

script.t: Please note that our flyer shows last season's prices and the wrong start time.
script.zh: 請注意，我們的傳單上印的是上一季的價格，而且開始時間有誤。

script.t: Brunch will begin at ten o'clock, not nine, so you can sleep in a little.
script.zh: 早午餐十點開始，不是九點，所以您可以多睡一會兒。

script.t: The Duo Table is now twenty-four dollars, but the Solo Plate is still fourteen.
script.zh: 雙人套餐現在是二十四美元，但單人餐盤仍是十四美元。

script.t: The Family Feast stays at forty-eight dollars, and it now serves five guests instead of four.
script.zh: 家庭大餐仍是四十八美元，而且現在可供五位客人享用，不再是四位。

script.t: Every package comes with unlimited coffee, although fresh juice costs an extra three dollars.
script.zh: 每個套餐都附無限續杯咖啡，不過鮮榨果汁要另加三美元。

script.t: If it rains, don't worry, because our indoor dining room will be open as well.
script.zh: 如果下雨也別擔心，因為我們的室內用餐區同樣開放。

script.t: Reservations are not required, but we recommend booking a table for groups of six or more.
script.zh: 不需訂位，但我們建議六人以上的團體預約座位。

script.t: To reserve your spot, visit lanternhouse.com and enter the code SUNDAY at checkout.
script.zh: 想預約座位，請上 lanternhouse.com，並在結帳時輸入代碼 SUNDAY。

script.t: Lantern House, where every Sunday feels like a holiday.
script.zh: Lantern House，讓每個週日都像假日。

q.t: Who is most likely the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：我們的主廚、我們的露台，且在推廣餐廳早午餐。
果園只是水果的來源。
沒有提到課程。
沒有提到住宿。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "Please note that our flyer shows last season's prices and the wrong start time."?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼說「Please note that our flyer shows last season's prices and the wrong start time.」？

choices.t: To correct information printed on the flyer
choices.why: 正解：隨後更正開始時間與價格。

choices.t: To announce that the flyer is free
choices.why: 沒有提到傳單是否免費。

choices.t: To say the restaurant has closed for the season
choices.why: 餐廳是秋天開始供應早午餐。

choices.t: To invite readers to design a new flyer
choices.why: 沒有提到設計。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much would a group of five guests pay for one brunch package?
q.zh: 請看圖表。五位客人買一份早午餐套餐要付多少錢？

choices.why: 正解：Family Feast 現在可供五位客人，價格仍是 48 美元。
24 美元是雙人套餐的新價格。
26 美元是傳單上雙人套餐的舊價格。
14 美元是單人餐盤。

level.why: 廣告內容單純，價格與優惠條件照字面出現。

script.t: Hungry for something fresh? Green Fork Cafe is now open on Main Street!
script.zh: 想吃點新鮮的嗎？Green Fork Cafe 現已在大街開幕！

script.t: Every sandwich and salad is made with vegetables from local farms.
script.zh: 每一份三明治與沙拉都使用當地農場的蔬菜。

script.t: Our lunch special costs only eight dollars and includes a drink.
script.zh: 我們的午間特餐只要八美元，還附一杯飲料。

script.t: It is served every weekday from eleven thirty to two o'clock.
script.zh: 每個平日從十一點半供應到兩點。

script.t: This week only, new customers get a free bowl of soup with any lunch special.
script.zh: 僅限本週，新客人點任一份午間特餐可免費獲得一碗湯。

script.t: We also offer fast delivery to offices within two miles.
script.zh: 我們也提供兩英里內辦公室的快速外送。

script.t: Call 555-0192 or visit our website to see the full menu.
script.zh: 請撥打 555-0192 或上網站查看完整菜單。

script.t: Green Fork Cafe: fresh food, friendly service, and a great price!
script.zh: Green Fork Cafe：新鮮美食、親切服務、超值價格！

q.t: What is being advertised?
q.zh: 廣告的是什麼？

choices.why: 正解：now open on Main Street → newly opened。
當地農場只是食材來源。
外送只是店家額外提供的服務之一。
全文沒有提到課程。

q.t: What comes with the lunch special?
q.zh: 午間特餐附什麼？

choices.why: 正解：includes a drink → A beverage。
湯只限本週新客人另有的優惠。
外送是另外的服務，沒說免費。
全文沒有提到甜點。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "This week only, new customers get a free bowl of soup with any lunch special."?
q.zh: 說話者說「This week only, new customers get a free bowl of soup with any lunch special.」是暗示什麼？

choices.why: 正解：This week only 表示優惠有期限，鼓勵盡早來店。
沒有提到菜單更動。

choices.t: Soup is always free at the cafe.
choices.why: 優惠只限本週與新客人。

choices.t: The cafe will close this week.
choices.why: This week only 指優惠期間，不是關店。

items.tag: 新菜單與過敏原提醒會議

level.why: 店內會議含新舊菜單轉折，需用同義換句判斷身份與意圖。

script.t: Before we open the doors tonight, I would like to go over a few changes to our menu.
script.zh: 在今晚開門營業前，我想先說明幾項菜單的更動。

script.t: First, the seafood pasta is now on the menu at eighteen dollars.
script.zh: 第一，海鮮義大利麵現在上菜單了，價格是十八美元。

script.t: It was a popular dish at our sister restaurant, but it contains shrimp.
script.zh: 它在我們的姊妹店很受歡迎，但是含有蝦子。

script.t: Several customers have allergies, so every server must ask about them before taking an order.
script.zh: 有幾位顧客會過敏，所以每位服務生在點餐前都必須詢問。

script.t: Second, we will no longer offer the chicken soup because the supplier raised its prices.
script.zh: 第二，我們不再供應雞湯，因為供應商調漲了價格。

script.t: However, the tomato soup will stay on the menu all winter.
script.zh: 不過，番茄湯整個冬天都會留在菜單上。

script.t: I know the new pasta takes longer to prepare, but please do not rush the cooking.
script.zh: 我知道新的義大利麵需要比較久的準備時間，但請不要趕著料理。

script.t: Quality is more important than speed during the first week.
script.zh: 第一週時，品質比速度更重要。

script.t: If you have any questions, please see me in my office after this meeting.
script.zh: 如果有任何問題，會後請到我的辦公室找我。

script.t: Thank you for your hard work, and let's have a great night.
script.zh: 感謝大家的辛勞，讓我們度過美好的一晚。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：開門前向服務生與廚師交代菜單與規定。
供應商只是被提到調漲價格的對象。
過敏的顧客是被服務生詢問的對象。
沒有提到教學或課程。

q.t: Why is the chicken soup being removed?
q.zh: 為什麼要撤下雞湯？

choices.t: Its ingredient costs have gone up.
choices.why: 正解：the supplier raised its prices → 成本上升。

choices.t: Some customers are allergic to it.
choices.why: 過敏是針對含蝦的海鮮義大利麵。

choices.t: It takes too long to prepare.
choices.why: 準備較久的是新的義大利麵。

choices.t: It is sold only in winter.
choices.why: 整個冬天都留下的是番茄湯。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when he says, "Quality is more important than speed during the first week."?
q.zh: 說話者說「Quality is more important than speed during the first week.」是什麼意思？

choices.t: Staff should cook carefully even if it takes time.
choices.zh: 員工即使花時間也應仔細烹調。
choices.why: 正解：前一句說新麵較費時，但請不要趕。

choices.t: Customers should wait longer for tables.
choices.zh: 顧客應該等久一點才有位子。
choices.why: 談的是烹調，不是帶位。

choices.t: The restaurant will close early that week.
choices.why: 沒有提到打烊時間。

choices.t: Servers should sell more dishes quickly.
choices.zh: 服務生應該快速多賣餐點。
choices.why: 與重視品質、不要趕的意思相反。

level.why: 電話留言連續更正人數、時間與品項，需辨識意圖與要求。

script.t: Hi, Ms. Tanaka, Marcus here from Silver Spoon Catering with an update on your order.
script.zh: 嗨，Tanaka 小姐，我是 Silver Spoon Catering 的 Marcus，來告知您訂單的最新情況。

script.t: Our records show lunch for fifty guests at your office this Friday at noon.
script.zh: 我們的紀錄顯示，您這週五中午在辦公室訂了五十人的午餐。

script.t: However, when I checked your email again, I saw that you actually asked for sixty guests.
script.zh: 不過我再次查看您的電子郵件，發現您其實要的是六十人。

script.t: I have already corrected the number, so you do not need to send anything new.
script.zh: 我已經更正人數，所以您不需要再寄任何新資料。

script.t: We were planning to deliver at eleven thirty, but our driver has another job nearby that morning.
script.zh: 我們原本打算十一點半送達，但司機那天早上附近有另一場工作。

script.t: So we will arrive at eleven fifteen to give our staff more time to set up.
script.zh: 所以我們會在十一點十五分抵達，讓我們的人員有更多時間佈置。

script.t: Your original request included ten vegetarian meals, and we will prepare twelve to be safe.
script.zh: 您原本要求十份素食餐，為保險起見我們會準備十二份。

script.t: This will raise the total cost by about forty dollars, which I will add to your invoice.
script.zh: 這會使總費用增加約四十美元，我會加到您的帳單上。

script.t: One more thing: the dessert tray you requested is no longer available because our baker is on vacation.
script.zh: 還有一件事：您訂的甜點拼盤已無法供應，因為我們的烘焙師正在休假。

script.t: We can offer a fruit platter at no charge instead.
script.zh: 我們可以改為免費提供水果拼盤。

script.t: Could you please let me know by tomorrow afternoon whether the fruit platter works for you?
script.zh: 可否請您在明天下午前告訴我，水果拼盤是否適合您？

script.t: You can reach me at 555-0176, and thank you for choosing Silver Spoon.
script.zh: 您可以撥 555-0176 找我，感謝您選擇 Silver Spoon。

q.t: Why is the speaker calling?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼來電？

choices.t: To update Ms. Tanaka about changes to her order
choices.zh: 告知 Tanaka 小姐訂單的更動
choices.why: 正解：更正人數、送達時間與甜點品項。

choices.t: To invite Ms. Tanaka to a food tasting
choices.why: 沒有提到試吃。

choices.t: To demand payment for an old bill
choices.why: 帳單只是新增費用的附帶說明。

choices.t: To apologize for a late delivery
choices.why: 餐點還沒送，且提早抵達。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when he says, "I have already corrected the number, so you do not need to send anything new."?
q.zh: 說話者說「I have already corrected the number, so you do not need to send anything new.」是什麼意思？

choices.t: Ms. Tanaka does not have to take action on the guest count.
choices.zh: Tanaka 小姐不必就人數採取行動。
choices.why: 正解：人數已由說話者更正。

choices.t: Ms. Tanaka should send another email.
choices.zh: Tanaka 小姐應再寄一封信。
choices.why: 說的是不需要寄新資料。

choices.t: The guest count is still fifty.
choices.why: 已更正為六十人。

choices.t: The company will charge a fee for changes.
choices.why: 收費的是增加的餐點，不是更改人數。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Ms. Tanaka to do by tomorrow afternoon?
q.zh: 說話者請 Tanaka 小姐在明天下午前做什麼？

choices.zh: 回覆關於替代品項的意見
choices.why: 正解：讓他知道水果拼盤是否可行。
帳單是之後才開立。
送達時間已由公司調整為十一點十五分。
說話者說不需要寄新資料。

level.why: 廣播節目預告，時間、費用與後續節目皆直接提到。

script.t: You are listening to Morning Menu on Radio 98, and I am your host, Nina.
script.zh: 您正在收聽 Radio 98 的《Morning Menu》，我是主持人 Nina。

script.t: This weekend, the city's Night Market Food Festival begins at Riverside Park.
script.zh: 本週末，城市的夜市美食節將在河濱公園登場。

script.t: More than thirty food stands will sell dumplings, noodles, and fresh fruit juice.
script.zh: 三十多個攤位將販售水餃、麵食和新鮮果汁。

script.t: Entry is free, but visitors must pay for the food they buy.
script.zh: 入場免費，但訪客必須為購買的食物付費。

script.t: The festival opens at five p.m. on Friday and closes at ten.
script.zh: 美食節週五下午五點開始，十點結束。

script.t: Because parking near the park is limited, the organizers suggest taking the bus.
script.zh: 由於公園附近的停車位有限，主辦單位建議搭公車。

script.t: Free shuttle buses will leave from the City Library every fifteen minutes.
script.zh: 免費接駁車每十五分鐘從市立圖書館出發。

script.t: Stay with us after the break, when a chef will share a simple noodle recipe.
script.zh: 請在廣告後繼續收聽，一位主廚將分享簡單的麵食食譜。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：Morning Menu on Radio 98, I am your host。
主辦單位是第三方，說話者只是轉述建議。
主廚是廣告後才會出現的來賓。
公車與接駁車只是交通資訊。

q.t: What can be inferred about parking near the park?
q.zh: 關於公園附近的停車，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: It may be hard to find a space.
choices.why: 正解：parking is limited → 車位可能不好找。
沒有提到停車費，十是結束時間。

choices.t: It is free for all visitors.
choices.why: 沒有提到免費停車；免費的是入場與接駁車。

choices.t: It is only available at the library.
choices.why: 圖書館是接駁車的出發地點。

q.t: What will listeners hear after the break?
q.zh: 聽眾在廣告後會聽到什麼？

choices.why: 正解：a chef will share a simple noodle recipe。
沒有提到路況報導。
入場免費，沒有提到門票。
接駁車班距已在前面提過，不是廣告後內容。

level.why: 新聞報導含轉折與表格更正，需結合圖表與獨白並做推論。

script.t: In local news this afternoon, the long-awaited Riverside Food Court will finally open next week.
script.zh: 今天下午的地方新聞，期待已久的河濱美食街下週終於要開幕了。

script.t: The mayor said the new building will bring more than two hundred jobs to the neighborhood.
script.zh: 市長表示，這棟新建築將為社區帶來兩百多個工作機會。

script.t: Four food stalls were scheduled to open on four different days, starting on Monday.
script.zh: 四個餐飲攤位原定從週一開始，分四天陸續開幕。

script.t: However, the Spice Corner stall will now open on Friday because its kitchen equipment arrived late.
script.zh: 不過，Spice Corner 攤位現在改在週五開幕，因為廚房設備延遲送達。

script.t: The other three stalls will follow the original schedule.
script.zh: 其他三個攤位會依照原定時程。

script.t: Parking is limited around the building, but the city has added two new bus routes.
script.zh: 大樓周邊停車位有限，但市府已新增兩條公車路線。

script.t: Many residents say they are excited, although some worry about noise at night.
script.zh: 許多居民表示很期待，不過有些人擔心夜間噪音。

script.t: The food court will be open from eleven in the morning until nine at night.
script.zh: 美食街營業時間為上午十一點到晚上九點。

script.t: We will bring you a full report from the opening ceremony on Monday.
script.zh: 週一我們會為您帶來開幕典禮的完整報導。

script.t: That is all for local news. I am Maria Gomez, and now back to the studio.
script.zh: 地方新聞就到這裡，我是 Maria Gomez，現在交還給攝影棚。

q.zh: 這則新聞主要在報導什麼？

choices.why: 正解：Riverside Food Court will finally open next week。

q.zh: 請看圖表。開幕日改變的攤位賣什麼食物？

Noodle House 照原定週一開幕。
Green Bowl 照原定時程。
Sweet Cart 照原定時程。

q.t: What can be inferred about the area around the food court?
q.zh: 關於美食街周邊地區，可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: Visitors are encouraged to take public transportation.
choices.zh: 鼓勵訪客搭乘大眾運輸。
choices.why: 正解：停車位有限，市府因此新增公車路線。
