items.tag: 老城區美食導覽行程調整

level.why: 導覽行程先說原計畫再更正，需理解推論與提問意圖。

script.t: Okay, everyone, please gather around, because our Old Town food tour is about to begin.
script.zh: 好的，各位請靠過來，我們的老城區美食導覽就要開始了。

script.t: We originally planned to visit five places, but one bakery closed for repairs this week.
script.zh: 我們原本計畫參觀五個地方，但有一家麵包店這週因整修而休息。

script.t: Instead, we will stop at four restaurants, and the final one is a family-run noodle shop.
script.zh: 改為停留四家餐廳，最後一家是家族經營的麵店。

script.t: Our first stop is a dumpling house that has operated in the same building for fifty years.
script.zh: 第一站是一間在同一棟建築營業了五十年的水餃店。

script.t: Most visitors order the shrimp dumplings, but the owner's grandmother's pork recipe is the real specialty.
script.zh: 多數遊客會點蝦餃，但老闆祖母的豬肉配方才是真正的招牌。

script.t: Next, we will walk five minutes to a tea house, where you can taste three kinds of local tea.
script.zh: 接著我們走五分鐘到一間茶館，您可以品嚐三種當地茶。

script.t: The brochure says the tour finishes at one o'clock, but we will actually end at one thirty.
script.zh: 手冊上寫導覽一點結束，但我們實際上會在一點半結束。

script.t: If you have to leave early, let me know now so I can arrange a taxi for you.
script.zh: 如果您得提早離開，請現在告訴我，我可以為您叫計程車。

script.t: Your ticket includes the food at all four places, but drinks at the noodle shop are extra.
script.zh: 您的票券包含四個地方的餐點，但麵店的飲料需另外付費。

script.t: Because the streets are narrow, please stay close and watch for bicycles.
script.zh: 由於街道狹窄，請靠近隊伍並留意腳踏車。

script.t: Does anyone have a dietary restriction?
script.zh: 有人有飲食限制嗎？

script.t: If so, please tell me before we enter the first restaurant.
script.zh: 如果有，請在我們進入第一家餐廳前告訴我。

script.t: Alright, let's get started, and please follow me.
script.zh: 好了，我們開始吧，請跟我來。

q.t: Why was the tour route changed?
q.zh: 導覽路線為什麼更動？

choices.t: One of the planned stops is under repair.
choices.zh: 其中一個原定停靠點在整修。
choices.why: 正解：one bakery closed for repairs。

choices.t: The weather is expected to be bad.
choices.why: 沒有提到天氣。
沒有提到票券售罄。

choices.t: The noodle shop moved to a new street.
choices.why: 麵店只是最後一站。

q.t: What can be inferred about the dumpling house?
q.zh: 關於水餃店可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: Its best-known dish is not the one most guests choose.
choices.zh: 最有特色的菜不是多數客人點的那道。
choices.why: 正解：多數人點蝦餃，但豬肉配方才是真正的招牌。

choices.t: It no longer serves pork dumplings.
choices.why: 豬肉配方是招牌。

choices.t: It is owned by the tour guide's family.
choices.zh: 它由導覽員的家人經營。
choices.why: 祖母是老闆的祖母，不是導覽員的。

choices.t: It has operated for only five years.
choices.why: 營業五十年；五是停靠點或步行分鐘數。

q.t: Why does the speaker ask, "Does anyone have a dietary restriction?"
q.zh: 說話者為什麼問「Does anyone have a dietary restriction?」

choices.t: To learn whether any guests need special food
choices.zh: 了解是否有客人需要特別餐點
choices.why: 正解：之後請有的人在進第一家餐廳前告知。

choices.t: To decide which tea to serve
choices.why: 茶只是第二站的介紹。

choices.t: To count guests who plan to leave early
choices.zh: 統計打算提早離開的客人
choices.why: 提早離開是另一個主題。
飲料費用是另外的說明。

level.why: 致詞含 but 轉折，需理解委婉說法並掌握具體細節與後續動作。

script.t: Friends, family, and loyal customers, thank you for being here to celebrate our tenth anniversary.
script.zh: 親友與忠實顧客們，感謝各位來慶祝我們的十週年。

script.t: Ten years ago, this restaurant had only six tables and a very small menu.
script.zh: 十年前，這間餐廳只有六張桌子和一份很小的菜單。

script.t: We were nervous, but a few kind neighbors came back every week and told their friends.
script.zh: 我們當時很緊張，但幾位親切的鄰居每週都回來，並告訴朋友。

script.t: Today we serve nearly four hundred guests on a busy weekend.
script.zh: 現在忙碌的週末我們接待近四百位客人。

script.t: Of course, success did not come from one person alone.
script.zh: 當然，成功不是靠一個人達成的。

script.t: I want to thank our cooks, who arrive before sunrise to prepare fresh bread.
script.zh: 我要感謝我們的廚師，他們在日出前就到店準備新鮮麵包。

script.t: Next month, we plan to open a second location across the river, but our original restaurant will always be our home.
script.zh: 下個月我們計畫在河對岸開第二家分店，但原本的餐廳永遠是我們的家。

script.t: To say thank you, every guest tonight will receive a coupon for a free appetizer on their next visit.
script.zh: 為了表達謝意，今晚每位客人都會拿到下次來店可兌換免費開胃菜的優惠券。

script.t: Now please raise your glasses, and let us enjoy the evening together.
script.zh: 現在請舉起酒杯，讓我們一起享受今晚。

q.t: How many tables did the restaurant have at first?
q.zh: 餐廳一開始有幾張桌子？

choices.why: 正解：only six tables → half a dozen。
十是週年的年數。
四百是現在週末接待的客人數。
第二家分店是下個月的計畫，與桌數無關。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when he says, "Of course, success did not come from one person alone."?
q.zh: 說話者說「Of course, success did not come from one person alone.」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He is crediting the efforts of his team.
choices.why: 正解：接著感謝廚師。

choices.t: He is asking for more help.
choices.why: 沒有提出需求。

choices.t: He is planning to sell the restaurant.
choices.why: 他說原本的餐廳永遠是家。
鄰居被提到的是友善與口碑。

q.t: What does the speaker ask the audience to do at the end?
q.zh: 說話者在結尾請聽眾做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：please raise your glasses。
第二家分店是下個月的計畫。
優惠券是下次來店使用。
全文沒有提到評論。

level.why: 賣場廣播單一主題，時間與原因照字面出現。

script.t: Excuse me, shoppers, we have a quick announcement from the Fresh Mart customer service desk.
script.zh: 各位顧客請注意，Fresh Mart 客服櫃檯有一則簡短廣播。

script.t: Our store will close at six o'clock tonight instead of ten o'clock.
script.zh: 本店今晚將在六點打烊，而不是十點。

script.t: We need extra time to change the price tags for tomorrow's big sale.
script.zh: 我們需要額外時間更換明天大特賣的價格標籤。

script.t: Please bring your items to the checkout counters by five forty-five.
script.zh: 請在五點四十五分前把商品帶到結帳櫃檯。

script.t: The bakery and the pharmacy will also close at six.
script.zh: 麵包坊和藥局也會在六點關門。

script.t: We will reopen at eight tomorrow morning with lower prices.
script.zh: 我們明天早上八點重新營業，價格會更低。

script.t: We are sorry for any trouble this may cause.
script.zh: 對於可能造成的不便，我們深表歉意。

script.t: Thank you for shopping at Fresh Mart.
script.zh: 感謝您在 Fresh Mart 購物。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：from the Fresh Mart customer service desk。
說話者是對顧客廣播，不是顧客。
藥局只是同樣提早關門的區域。
沒有提到送貨。

q.t: What is the announcement mainly about?
q.zh: 這則廣播主要與什麼有關？

choices.t: A change in the store's closing time
choices.why: 正解：六點打烊而不是十點。

choices.t: The opening of a new bakery
choices.why: 麵包坊只是同樣提早關門。
大特賣是隔天的事，且不是主旨。

choices.t: A lost item at the checkout
choices.why: 沒有提到遺失物。

q.t: Why does the store need extra time?
q.zh: 商店為什麼需要額外時間？

choices.t: To update prices for a sale
choices.why: 正解：change the price tags → update prices。
沒有提到訓練。
麵包坊只是同樣關門。
藥局只是同樣關門。

items.tag: 節慶期間退換貨規定說明會

level.why: 店務會議含轉折與規定，需用同義換句判斷聽眾與說話意圖。

script.t: Thanks for staying after closing, everyone, because I need to go over our holiday plans.
script.zh: 謝謝大家打烊後留下來，因為我需要說明我們的節慶期間計畫。

script.t: First, the store will open at seven a.m. instead of nine on the Friday after Thanksgiving.
script.zh: 第一，感恩節後的那個週五，本店將在上午七點開門，而不是九點。

script.t: We expected a quiet morning, but last year the line reached the parking lot by eight.
script.zh: 我們原本預期早上會很安靜，但去年八點時排隊人龍就排到停車場了。

script.t: So each cashier will work with a helper to keep the lines moving.
script.zh: 所以每位收銀員都會搭配一位助手，讓隊伍保持前進。

script.t: Second, the return period for gifts will be extended to forty-five days, not thirty.
script.zh: 第二，禮品的退貨期限將延長為四十五天，而不是三十天。

script.t: However, items without a receipt can only be exchanged for store credit.
script.zh: 不過，沒有收據的商品只能換成店內購物金。

script.t: Please do not promise anything outside this policy, even if a customer gets upset.
script.zh: 即使顧客不高興，也請不要承諾超出這項規定的事。

script.t: If a customer insists, call a manager to the front desk.
script.zh: 如果顧客堅持，請叫經理到服務台。

script.t: Please check the new schedule on the staff board before you leave tonight.
script.zh: 離開前請先看員工布告欄上的新班表。

script.t: Thanks again, and let's make this our best season yet.
script.zh: 再次感謝大家，讓我們讓這季成為最好的一季。

q.t: Who is the speaker most likely addressing?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是在對誰說話？

choices.why: 正解：打烊後的店務說明，提到收銀員與班表。
顧客只是員工服務的對象。
沒有提到送貨。
沒有提到保全工作。

q.t: How long will customers have to return gifts?
q.zh: 顧客有多久時間可以退回禮品？

choices.why: 正解：forty-five days → 一個半月。
三十天是舊的期限。
沒有提到一週。
期限是以天數計算。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "Please do not promise anything outside this policy, even if a customer gets upset."?
q.zh: 說話者說「Please do not promise anything outside this policy, even if a customer gets upset.」是暗示什麼？

choices.t: Employees should follow the official return rules.
choices.zh: 員工應遵守正式的退貨規定。
choices.why: 正解：不要承諾規定之外的事。

choices.t: Employees may offer longer returns to upset customers.
choices.zh: 員工可以給不高興的顧客更長的退貨期。
choices.why: 與說話者要求相反。

choices.t: Customers should call a manager first.
choices.why: 叫經理是顧客堅持時才做的事。

choices.t: The return period will end soon.
choices.why: 期限是延長，不是即將結束。

level.why: 廣告先講舊折扣再更正為新折扣，需對照圖表；含意圖題。

script.t: Looking for the perfect upgrade for your home office? Welcome to the Brightway Furniture Weekend Warehouse Sale.
script.zh: 想為居家辦公室找到最理想的升級嗎？歡迎來到 Brightway Furniture 的週末倉庫特賣。

script.t: This Saturday and Sunday only, every item in our office collection is marked down.
script.zh: 只限本週六、日，辦公家具系列的每件商品都降價。

script.t: Last week we advertised twenty percent off desks, but we have decided to do even better.
script.zh: 上週我們宣傳書桌打八折，但我們決定做得更好。

script.t: All desks are now thirty percent off, and chairs remain fifteen percent off.
script.zh: 現在所有書桌打七折，椅子仍是八五折。

script.t: Our bookshelves are twenty-five percent off, and filing cabinets are ten percent off.
script.zh: 書架打七五折，檔案櫃打九折。

script.t: Please note that lamps are not included in this promotion.
script.zh: 請注意燈具不在這次促銷範圍內。

script.t: If you spend more than five hundred dollars, we will deliver your purchase for free anywhere in the city.
script.zh: 如果消費超過五百美元，我們將免費配送到市內任何地點。

script.t: Otherwise, delivery costs forty dollars, and assembly is available for an additional fee.
script.zh: 否則運費為四十美元，組裝服務需另外收費。

script.t: Our warehouse is at 88 Dock Road, right behind the Greenfield train station.
script.zh: 倉庫位在 Dock Road 88 號，就在 Greenfield 火車站後面。

script.t: Free parking is available, but the lot fills up quickly on Saturday morning, so come early.
script.zh: 有免費停車位，但週六早上很快就滿，所以請早點來。

script.t: We open at nine and close at six both days. We hope to see you there!
script.zh: 兩天都是九點開門、六點打烊。希望在那裡見到您！

q.t: What is being advertised?
q.zh: 廣告的是什麼？

choices.why: warehouse 只是特賣地點。
配送只是附帶的優惠條件。
正解：Weekend Warehouse Sale 是家具店的特賣活動。
火車站只是指引位置。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which category received a larger discount than originally advertised?
q.zh: 請看圖表。哪個類別的折扣比原先宣傳的更大？

choices.why: 椅子仍是 15%，沒有改變。
正解：原本 20%，現在 30%。
書架 25% 與圖表相同。
檔案櫃 10% 與圖表相同。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "the lot fills up quickly on Saturday morning"?
q.zh: 說話者說「週六早上停車場很快就滿」暗示什麼？

choices.why: 前面明說 free parking。
營業時間是九點到六點。
正解：停車位會很快滿，所以 come early。
沒有這樣建議。

items.tag: 平板電腦取貨通知留言

level.why: 電話留言內容單純，取貨期限與聯絡方式照字面出現。

script.t: This message is for Ms. Lopez. I am calling from City Electronics on Grand Avenue.
script.zh: 這是留給 Lopez 小姐的訊息。我從大街上的 City Electronics 來電。

script.t: The tablet you ordered last week has arrived at our store.
script.zh: 您上週訂的平板電腦已經到我們店裡了。

script.t: You can pick it up any day from nine a.m. to eight p.m.
script.zh: 您可以每天上午九點到晚上八點來取貨。

script.t: Please bring your photo ID and the order receipt.
script.zh: 請帶您的附照片證件和訂購收據。

script.t: We will keep the tablet for you until Saturday.
script.zh: 我們會幫您保留平板電腦到週六。

script.t: After that, we will put it back on the shelf for other customers.
script.zh: 之後我們會把它放回架上給其他顧客。

script.t: If you need more time, please call us at 555-0134.
script.zh: 如果您需要更多時間，請撥 555-0134 給我們。

script.t: Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you.
script.zh: 謝謝您，期待您的光臨。

q.t: Why is the speaker calling?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼來電？

choices.t: To say an order is ready for pickup
choices.zh: 告知訂購商品可以取貨
choices.why: 正解：the tablet you ordered has arrived → pick it up。

choices.t: To offer a discount on tablets
choices.why: 沒有提到折扣。
沒有提到付款。
說話者是通知取貨，不是退貨。

q.t: What will probably happen if Ms. Lopez does not come by Saturday?
q.zh: 如果 Lopez 小姐週六前沒來，可能會發生什麼事？

choices.t: The tablet may be offered to other customers.
choices.zh: 平板電腦可能會提供給其他顧客。
choices.why: 正解：put it back on the shelf for other customers。

choices.t: The tablet will be shipped to her home.
choices.why: 沒有提到寄送。
沒有提到修理。

choices.t: The tablet will be held until Sunday.
choices.zh: 平板電腦會保留到週日。
choices.why: 保留期限是到週六。

q.t: What should Ms. Lopez do if she needs more time?
q.zh: 如果 Lopez 小姐需要更多時間，應該怎麼做？

choices.why: 正解：please call us at 555-0134。
證件是取貨時要帶的東西。
九點是營業開始時間。
沒有提到重新訂購。

items.tag: 雜貨店週末營業時間調整報導

level.why: 新聞報導需結合營業時間表與獨白更正，並推論活動影響。

script.t: In consumer news today, Greenfield Market, the city's largest grocery store, has announced changes to its weekend schedule.
script.zh: 今天的消費新聞，全市最大的雜貨店 Greenfield Market 宣布調整週末營業時間。

script.t: The store is usually open until eight p.m. on Saturdays, but it will close at five this week.
script.zh: 該店週六通常營業到晚上八點，但本週將在五點關門。

script.t: Managers say the nearby Harvest Street Festival will block most roads in the afternoon.
script.zh: 經理表示，附近的 Harvest Street 慶典下午會封閉大部分道路。

script.t: They expect fewer shoppers than usual, and many employees will be volunteering at the festival.
script.zh: 他們預期顧客會比平常少，而且許多員工將到慶典當志工。

script.t: Sunday hours will not change, so customers can still shop from ten to six.
script.zh: 週日時間不變，所以顧客仍可在十點到六點購物。

script.t: However, the in-store bakery will be closed all day Saturday because of a staff shortage.
script.zh: 不過，店內麵包坊週六整天關閉，因為人手不足。

script.t: To help shoppers, the store will let customers order online and pick up groceries at the side entrance.
script.zh: 為了幫助顧客，店家讓顧客線上訂購後，到側門領取雜貨。

script.t: Online orders must be placed before noon on Friday.
script.zh: 線上訂單必須在週五中午前下單。

script.t: That is the latest from the business desk. I am Julia Reyes, reporting.
script.zh: 以上是商業新聞組的最新消息，我是 Julia Reyes 為您報導。

q.t: What is the report mainly about?
q.zh: 這則報導主要在談什麼？

choices.t: A change to a store's weekend hours
choices.zh: 商店週末營業時間的更動
choices.why: 正解：announced changes to its weekend schedule。

choices.t: The opening of a street festival
choices.why: 慶典只是調整的原因。
沒有提到價格。

choices.t: The opening of a new bakery
choices.why: 麵包坊只是週六暫停營業。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How long will Greenfield Market be open on Saturday?
q.zh: 請看圖表。Greenfield Market 週六將營業多久？

choices.why: 正解：圖表顯示九點開門，獨白更正為五點關門，共八小時。
九點到晚上八點是原本的十一小時。
九是開門時間，不是營業時數。
五是關門時間，不是營業時數。

q.t: What is implied about the Harvest Street Festival?
q.zh: 關於 Harvest Street 慶典暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It will make travel to the store harder.
choices.zh: 它會讓前往商店更困難。
choices.why: 正解：道路下午會被封閉，顧客預計減少。

choices.t: It will take place inside the store.
choices.why: 慶典在附近街道舉行。
只說明本週六下午封路。

choices.t: It is organized by Greenfield Market.
choices.zh: 它由 Greenfield Market 主辦。
choices.why: 員工只是去當志工。

items.tag: 百貨週末特賣折扣更正廣播

level.why: 賣場廣播連續更正開始時間與各樓層折扣，需對照圖表與獨白判斷。

script.t: Shoppers at Brookfield Department Store, we have a few updates about this weekend's sale.
script.zh: Brookfield 百貨的顧客請注意，我們有幾項關於本週末特賣的更新。

script.t: First, the sale will begin at nine a.m. on Saturday, not at ten as advertised in the newspaper.
script.zh: 首先，特賣週六上午九點開始，而不是報紙上刊登的十點。

script.t: Please note that the printed schedule lists furniture at forty percent off.
script.zh: 請注意，印刷的時程表上家具是六折。

script.t: Because of high demand, however, the furniture discount has been lowered to thirty percent.
script.zh: 不過，由於需求很高，家具折扣已調降為七折。

script.t: On the other hand, the toy department has increased its discount from twenty-five to forty-five percent.
script.zh: 另一方面，玩具部門的折扣已從七五折提高到五五折。

script.t: Cosmetics and clothing prices remain the same as shown on the schedule.
script.zh: 化妝品與服飾的價格維持與時程表相同。

script.t: Coupons cannot be combined with sale prices, but they can be used on regular-priced items.
script.zh: 優惠券不能與特價疊用，但可用於原價商品。

script.t: Parking will be free for the first three hours, although valet service is unavailable this weekend.
script.zh: 前三小時停車免費，不過本週末不提供代客泊車。

script.t: If you are carrying heavy bags, our staff can hold them at the customer service desk.
script.zh: 如果您提著沉重的袋子，我們的人員可以幫您寄放在客服櫃檯。

script.t: Shoppers who spend over two hundred dollars will receive a free tote bag at the second-floor information counter.
script.zh: 消費超過兩百美元的顧客，可在二樓詢問台領取免費托特包。

script.t: Please remember to keep your proof of purchase in case you need to exchange an item.
script.zh: 請記得保留購買證明，以便需要換貨時使用。

script.t: Thank you for shopping at Brookfield, and enjoy the rest of your day.
script.zh: 感謝您在 Brookfield 購物，祝您有愉快的一天。

q.t: When will the sale begin on Saturday?
q.zh: 特賣週六幾點開始？

choices.why: 正解：九點開始，而不是報紙上的十點。
十點是報紙上刊登的舊時間。
沒有提到中午。
沒有提到週五。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which floor now has the biggest discount?
q.zh: 請看圖表。現在哪一層樓的折扣最大？

choices.why: 正解：玩具折扣提高到 45%，圖表顯示玩具在四樓。
家具原本 40%，現已降到 30%。
服飾維持 30%。
化妝品維持 20%。

q.t: What does the speaker remind shoppers to do?
q.zh: 說話者提醒顧客做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：keep your proof of purchase。

choices.t: Leave their bags at the service desk
choices.zh: 把袋子寄放在客服櫃檯
choices.why: 寄放是店方提供的選擇，不是提醒事項。
托特包是消費滿額的贈品。

choices.zh: 在特價商品上使用優惠券
choices.why: 優惠券不能與特價疊用。

level.why: 廣告折扣、條件與贈品照字面出現。

script.t: Back to school means new shoes, and Step Right Shoes has the best deals in town!
script.zh: 開學季就是要買新鞋，Step Right Shoes 有全城最划算的優惠！

script.t: From Friday to Sunday, all children's sneakers are thirty percent off.
script.zh: 週五到週日，所有兒童運動鞋打七折。

script.t: Adult sneakers are twenty percent off during the same three days.
script.zh: 成人運動鞋在同樣三天打八折。

script.t: Spend over sixty dollars, and you will get a free pair of socks.
script.zh: 消費超過六十美元，就送一雙免費襪子。

script.t: Our friendly staff can measure your child's feet for free.
script.zh: 我們親切的店員可以免費幫您的孩子量腳。

script.t: Come early on Friday, because the first fifty customers will also receive a free backpack.
script.zh: 週五請早點來，因為前五十位顧客還可獲贈免費背包。

script.t: We are located next to the City Library, and parking is free.
script.zh: 我們位於市立圖書館旁邊，停車免費。

script.t: Step Right Shoes: the right fit at the right price!
script.zh: Step Right Shoes：合適的尺寸，合適的價格！

q.t: What can be inferred about the sale?
q.zh: 關於這場特賣可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It is aimed at families preparing for school.
choices.why: 正解：Back to school 與兒童運動鞋折扣。

choices.t: It is only for adult shoppers.
choices.why: 兒童運動鞋折扣更高，成人也有折扣。

choices.t: It lasts for the whole month.
choices.why: 只有週五到週日三天。

choices.t: It is held at the library.
choices.why: 圖書館只是店鋪位置的參照點。

q.t: What must customers do to get free socks?
q.zh: 顧客要怎麼做才能得到免費襪子？

choices.why: 正解：Spend over sixty dollars。
沒有買兩雙的條件。
週五早到是為了拿背包。
沒有提到舊鞋。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when she says, "Come early on Friday, because the first fifty customers will also receive a free backpack."?
q.zh: 說話者說「Come early on Friday, because the first fifty customers will also receive a free backpack.」是暗示什麼？

choices.why: 正解：前五十位才有背包，所以要早到。

choices.t: The store opens at six in the morning.
choices.why: 沒有提到開門時間。
背包是免費贈品。

choices.t: Staff will explain how to measure feet.
choices.why: 量腳是另一項服務。

items.tag: 冬季外套購物建議節目

level.why: 廣播節目提供購物建議，含反直覺說法與轉折，需推論並預測後續節目。

script.t: Welcome back to Smart Shopper Hour, the show that helps your money go further.
script.zh: 歡迎回到《Smart Shopper Hour》，這個讓您錢花得更值得的節目。

script.t: Today's tip is about buying winter coats, and many people make the same mistake.
script.zh: 今天的小撇步是關於買冬季外套，而很多人都犯同樣的錯。

script.t: They wait until December, thinking prices will drop even lower.
script.zh: 他們等到十二月，以為價格會再降更多。

script.t: In fact, most stores offer their best coat prices in late October, while December selection is limited.
script.zh: 事實上，多數商店在十月底提供最好的外套價格，而十二月可選擇的款式有限。

script.t: By December, popular sizes are often sold out, so the savings do not matter.
script.zh: 到了十二月，熱門尺寸常常已經售完，省下的錢也就沒有意義。

script.t: My advice is to compare at least three stores before you buy.
script.zh: 我的建議是購買前至少比較三家商店。

script.t: Also check the return policy, because some stores charge a fee if you send an item back.
script.zh: 也要確認退貨規定，因為有些商店在您退貨時會收費。

script.t: Finally, sign up for store emails, but create a separate address so your main inbox does not fill up.
script.zh: 最後，請訂閱商店電子報，但要另外建立一個信箱，以免主要信箱被塞滿。

script.t: That is all the time we have today, and tomorrow we will talk about buying electronics online.
script.zh: 今天的時間就到這裡，明天我們將談談網購電子產品。

script.t: Thanks for listening, and happy shopping!
script.zh: 感謝收聽，祝購物愉快！

q.t: When do most stores offer the best coat prices?
q.zh: 多數商店何時提供最好的外套價格？

choices.why: 正解：late October。
十二月是多數人誤以為最便宜的時候。
沒有提到一月。
沒有提到假日後的折扣。

q.t: What can be inferred about shoppers who wait until December?
q.zh: 關於等到十二月才買的顧客，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: They may have fewer sizes to choose from.
choices.zh: 他們可選的尺寸可能比較少。
choices.why: 正解：熱門尺寸常常已售完。

choices.t: They will pay less than October shoppers.
choices.zh: 他們會比十月買的人付得少。
choices.why: 與說話者的說法相反。

choices.t: They can return items for free.
choices.why: 有些商店退貨要收費。

choices.zh: 他們會最先收到電子報。
choices.why: 電子報是另一項建議。

q.t: What will the speaker discuss tomorrow?
q.zh: 說話者明天會談什麼？

choices.t: Shopping for devices on the internet
choices.zh: 在網路上購買電子產品
choices.why: 正解：buying electronics online。
這是今天的主題。
這只是今天的小建議之一。
退貨費用只是今天提到的提醒。

level.why: 電話留言先說原訂內容再更正為替代方案，需推論與理解催促意圖。

script.t: Good evening, Ms. Nguyen, Ravi here at Urban Home, following up on your sofa order.
script.zh: Nguyen 小姐晚安，我是 Urban Home 的 Ravi，來跟進您的沙發訂單。

script.t: When you ordered, I told you the gray sofa would be delivered on Wednesday.
script.zh: 您下單時，我告訴您灰色沙發會在週三送達。

script.t: Unfortunately, I made a mistake, because the gray model is out of stock until next month.
script.zh: 很抱歉，我弄錯了，因為灰色款要到下個月才有貨。

script.t: What we do have is the same sofa in dark blue, which arrived in our stockroom this morning.
script.zh: 我們現有的是同款深藍色，今天早上已到倉庫。

script.t: I can deliver it on Thursday between one and five p.m., and I will waive the twenty-dollar delivery fee.
script.zh: 我可以在週四下午一點到五點之間送達，並免除二十美元運費。

script.t: If you would rather wait for the gray one, I will hold your deposit until it comes in.
script.zh: 如果您寧可等灰色款，我會保留您的訂金，直到到貨。

script.t: Of course, I understand if you have your heart set on gray.
script.zh: 當然，我理解您如果心裡一直想要灰色。

script.t: The blue fabric costs less, so your final price would drop by fifty dollars.
script.zh: 藍色布料比較便宜，所以您的最終價格會減少五十美元。

script.t: Please call me back at 555-0187 before tomorrow at noon to let me know which you prefer.
script.zh: 請在明天中午前回電 555-0187，告訴我您偏好哪一種。

script.t: If I do not hear from you, I will assume you want the blue sofa on Thursday.
script.zh: 如果沒有收到您的回覆，我會當作您要週四送達的藍色沙發。

script.t: Again, I apologize for the confusion, and thank you for your patience.
script.zh: 再次為造成的混淆致歉，並感謝您的耐心。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：Urban Home，處理沙發訂單與送貨安排。
他只是安排送貨，並非負責開車的人。
沒有提到製造。
他是在處理 Nguyen 小姐的訂單。

q.t: What can be inferred about the gray sofa?
q.zh: 關於灰色沙發可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It will not be available for several weeks.
choices.why: 正解：下個月才有貨，願意等的話會保留訂金。

choices.t: It costs less than the blue sofa.
choices.why: 便宜的是藍色布料。
只說缺貨到下個月，之後會到貨。

choices.t: It will be delivered on Thursday.
choices.why: 週四送的是藍色款。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "If I do not hear from you, I will assume you want the blue sofa on Thursday."?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼說「If I do not hear from you, I will assume you want the blue sofa on Thursday.」？

choices.t: To encourage Ms. Nguyen to reply promptly
choices.zh: 鼓勵 Nguyen 小姐盡快回覆
choices.why: 正解：沒收到回覆就視為選藍色，所以請她及時回電。
沒有要取消訂單。
沒有提到收費。
週三是原本錯誤告知的日期。

items.tag: 主要道路封閉交通報導

level.why: 路況廣播單一主題，封路原因與完工時間照字面出現。

script.t: Good morning, commuters, and welcome to the Seven O'Clock Traffic Update on Radio 101.
script.zh: 通勤的朋友早安，歡迎收聽 Radio 101 的七點交通快報。

script.t: Main Street is closed between Fifth Avenue and Oak Road because of a broken water pipe.
script.zh: 由於水管破裂，Main Street 在第五大道與 Oak Road 之間封閉。

script.t: Repair crews expect to finish the work by noon.
script.zh: 維修人員預計在中午前完工。

script.t: Drivers should use Park Avenue instead, but traffic there is moving slowly.
script.zh: 駕駛人請改走 Park Avenue，不過那裡車流很慢。

script.t: The number 12 bus is also running about fifteen minutes late.
script.zh: 12 路公車也大約誤點十五分鐘。

script.t: If you can, leave home early or take the subway.
script.zh: 如果可以，請提早出門或搭地鐵。

script.t: Check back at eight o'clock for another update.
script.zh: 八點請再回來收聽下一次更新。

script.t: This is Tina Brooks, and have a safe trip to work.
script.zh: 我是 Tina Brooks，祝各位上班路上平安。

q.t: What is the report mainly about?
q.zh: 這則報導主要在談什麼？

choices.why: 正解：Main Street 因水管破裂封閉。
公車只是同樣誤點的交通工具。
地鐵只是替代選項，沒提票價。
沒有提到遊行。

q.t: When will the repair work probably finish?
q.zh: 維修工作大概何時完成？

choices.why: 正解：by noon。
八點是下次交通快報的時間。
七點是這個節目的時間。
沒有提到明天。

q.t: What can be inferred about Park Avenue?
q.zh: 關於 Park Avenue 可以推論什麼？

choices.t: It may be crowded this morning.
choices.why: 正解：traffic there is moving slowly。
封閉的是 Main Street。
沒有提到 Park Avenue 的公車。

choices.t: It is faster than Main Street.
choices.why: Park Avenue 車流很慢。

level.why: 車站廣播含更正與推論，需同義換句。

script.t: Attention, passengers traveling to Riverside on the 4:15 express train.
script.zh: 前往 Riverside、搭乘 4:15 特快車的旅客請注意。

script.t: Due to a signal problem, this train will now depart from Platform 6 instead of Platform 3.
script.zh: 由於號誌問題，這班列車現在改從 6 號月台出發，而不是 3 號月台。

script.t: Passengers who are already waiting on Platform 3 should use the stairs near the ticket office.
script.zh: 已在 3 號月台等候的旅客，請利用售票處旁的樓梯。

script.t: The elevator is out of service, but station staff will assist anyone who needs help with luggage.
script.zh: 電梯停用，但站務人員會協助需要搬運行李的旅客。

script.t: The departure has been delayed by approximately twenty minutes, so the train will now leave at 4:35.
script.zh: 發車時間延誤約二十分鐘，所以列車現在將於 4:35 出發。

script.t: Tickets will remain valid, and no new reservation is required.
script.zh: 車票仍然有效，不需要重新劃位。

script.t: If you would like a refund, please visit the service counter near Gate B.
script.zh: 如果想退費，請到 B 閘門旁的服務櫃檯。

script.t: We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
script.zh: 對於造成的不便深表歉意，感謝您的耐心。

q.t: What is the announcement mainly about?
q.zh: 這則廣播主要是關於什麼？

choices.why: 沒有提到票價調整。
車站並未關閉。

choices.t: A change to a train schedule
choices.why: 正解：月台改變且延誤二十分鐘。
沒有提到遺失物品。

q.t: What can be inferred about the passengers on Platform 3?
q.zh: 關於 3 號月台的旅客可推論出什麼？

choices.why: 退費要自己到服務櫃檯。
列車還沒出發。
Tickets will remain valid。

choices.t: They need to move to another platform.
choices.zh: 他們需要換到另一個月台。
choices.why: 正解：列車改由 6 號月台出發，所以得移動。

q.t: What should passengers do if they want their money back?
q.zh: 旅客如果想退費該怎麼做？

choices.why: 正解：visit the service counter → go to a service counter。
售票處是旁邊樓梯的位置參照。
說明不需要重新劃位。
沒有提到專線。

items.tag: 榆樹街試辦計畫日期更正會議

level.why: 先說週五啟用再更正為週一，資訊密集，含意圖題與未來行動題

script.t: Let's get started, because we have a lot to cover about the Elm Street pilot project.
script.zh: 我們開始吧，因為關於榆樹街試辦計畫還有很多內容要談。

script.t: Last week, I told you the new bike lanes would open this Friday.
script.zh: 上週我告訴過大家，新的自行車道會在本週五啟用。

script.t: That date has changed, and the new opening day is Monday, March 3.
script.zh: 這個日期已經更改，新的啟用日是3月3日星期一。

script.t: The contractor needs two extra days to repaint the crosswalks at Fifth Avenue.
script.zh: 承包商需要多兩天時間，重新漆好第五大道的行人穿越道。

script.t: Until then, Elm Street will stay one-way heading north, as it is now.
script.zh: 在那之前，榆樹街會維持現狀，繼續是向北的單行道。

script.t: Once the pilot begins, vehicles will only be allowed to turn left at the Oak intersection.
script.zh: 試辦開始後，車輛在橡樹路口只能左轉。

script.t: I know some shop owners are worried that fewer parking spaces will hurt business.
script.zh: 我知道有些店家擔心停車位減少會影響生意。

script.t: To address that, we will add six short-term loading zones in front of the stores.
script.zh: 為了處理這點，我們會在店門口增設六個短時間的上下貨區。

script.t: Our team will count pedestrians and cyclists every weekday for the first month.
script.zh: 我們的團隊在第一個月每個工作日都會計算行人與單車騎士的數量。

script.t: Please remember that these numbers will decide whether the pilot becomes permanent.
script.zh: 請記得，這些數字將決定試辦計畫能否成為長期措施。

script.t: Maria, I would like your group to design the new signage by next Wednesday.
script.zh: 瑪麗亞，我希望妳的小組在下週三前設計好新的標示。

script.t: Everyone else, please send me your comments on the traffic plan before we meet again.
script.zh: 其他人，請在我們下次開會前把對交通計畫的意見寄給我。

script.t: That is all for now, so let's take a short break.
script.zh: 目前就到這裡，我們先休息一下吧。

q.t: What is the main topic of the talk?
q.zh: 這段談話的主要主題是什麼？

choices.t: A delay in a road improvement project
choices.why: 說話者更正啟用日，從週五改為下週一。

choices.t: The results of a traffic count
choices.why: 計數是之後才要做的，尚無結果。

choices.t: A request for more parking spaces
choices.why: 擔心停車位減少的是店家，說話者並未提出此要求。

choices.t: The cancellation of a bike lane plan
choices.why: 計畫只是延後，並未取消。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "I know some shop owners are worried that fewer parking spaces will hurt business"?
q.zh: 說話者說「I know some shop owners are worried that fewer parking spaces will hurt business」時，暗示什麼？

choices.t: He is about to offer a way to ease their concern.
choices.zh: 他即將提出緩解店家疑慮的做法。
choices.why: 下一句說明會增設短時間上下貨區。

choices.t: He believes the pilot should be canceled.
choices.zh: 他認為試辦計畫應該取消。
choices.why: 他仍繼續說明試辦計畫的後續安排。

choices.t: He plans to remove the loading zones.
choices.why: 他說的是要增設上下貨區。

choices.t: He wants the shop owners to join the team.
choices.why: 獨白未提及邀請店家加入。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Maria's group to do?
q.zh: 說話者要求瑪麗亞的小組做什麼？

choices.why: signage 即 road signs，期限為下週三。
這是承包商的工作。
這是整個團隊第一個月的任務，並非指派給瑪麗亞的小組。

choices.t: Send comments on the traffic plan
choices.zh: 寄出對交通計畫的意見
choices.why: 這是對其他所有人的要求。

level.why: 車站廣播單一主題，替代做法與提醒照字面出現。

script.t: May I have your attention, travelers at Central Station?
script.zh: 中央車站的旅客請注意。

script.t: The ticket machines near Gate B are not working today.
script.zh: B 閘門附近的售票機今天無法使用。

script.t: Please buy your tickets at the main ticket window instead.
script.zh: 請改到主售票窗口購票。

script.t: The window is open from six a.m. to ten p.m.
script.zh: 窗口營業時間是上午六點到晚上十點。

script.t: If you already have a ticket, you may go directly to the platform.
script.zh: 如果您已有車票，可以直接前往月台。

script.t: Please keep your ticket with you until you leave the station.
script.zh: 請將車票帶在身上，直到離開車站。

script.t: Our staff in yellow jackets can help you if you have any questions.
script.zh: 穿黃色外套的工作人員可以協助您解答疑問。

script.t: We are sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your understanding.
script.zh: 造成不便，我們深感抱歉，也感謝您的諒解。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：對車站旅客廣播，並提到我們的工作人員。
沒有提到駕駛列車。
說話者是對旅客廣播。
售票機故障只是公告內容。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "The ticket machines near Gate B are not working today."?
q.zh: 說話者說「The ticket machines near Gate B are not working today.」是暗示什麼？

choices.t: Travelers need another way to buy tickets.
choices.zh: 旅客需要用其他方式購票。
choices.why: 正解：接著請旅客改到售票窗口。

choices.t: Gate B is closed to all passengers.
choices.zh: B 閘門不開放給所有旅客。
choices.why: 只說售票機故障，沒說閘門關閉。
沒有提到免費。
沒有提到提早關閉。

q.t: What does the speaker ask travelers to do with their tickets?
q.zh: 說話者請旅客怎麼處理車票？

choices.t: Hold on to them until leaving the station
choices.why: 正解：keep your ticket with you until you leave。
B 閘門附近的售票機故障。

choices.t: Show them to staff in yellow jackets
choices.zh: 出示給穿黃外套的人員
choices.why: 黃外套人員只是負責解答疑問。
十點是售票窗口的結束時間。

items.tag: 海港大橋維修時程調整報導

level.why: 新聞報導含轉折與時程更正，需結合表格判斷並理解意圖。

script.t: In local news this morning, repairs on Harbor Bridge will begin next Monday.
script.zh: 今天早上的地方新聞，Harbor 大橋的維修將從下週一開始。

script.t: City officials say the bridge is safe, but years of heavy traffic have worn down the road surface.
script.zh: 市府官員表示橋是安全的，但多年的大量車流已經磨損了路面。

script.t: The work will take three days, with different lanes closed each day.
script.zh: 工程將進行三天，每天封閉不同的車道。

script.t: However, the city has changed its plan, and Tuesday's work will now take place on Thursday because rain is expected.
script.zh: 不過，市府改變了計畫，週二的工程因預期下雨，改到週四進行。

script.t: On Wednesday, all lanes will close for one night, but the closing time has moved from ten p.m. to eleven p.m.
script.zh: 週三晚上將封閉所有車道一晚，但封閉時間已從晚上十點改到十一點。

script.t: Drivers are encouraged to use Bay Tunnel, though it is expected to be busy.
script.zh: 市府鼓勵駕駛人改走 Bay 隧道，不過預期那裡會很繁忙。

script.t: Buses will follow their regular schedules, and fares will not increase.
script.zh: 公車將依平常班表行駛，票價也不會調漲。

script.t: The mayor said she is sorry for the trouble, but the repairs cannot wait any longer.
script.zh: 市長表示對造成的不便感到抱歉，但維修不能再拖了。

script.t: For updated maps, visit the city website. I am Karen Lee, reporting.
script.zh: 最新地圖請上市府網站查詢。我是 Karen Lee 為您報導。

q.t: According to city officials, why are repairs needed?
q.zh: 根據市府官員，為什麼需要維修？

choices.t: The road surface has worn out.
choices.why: 正解：years of heavy traffic have worn down the road surface。

choices.t: The bridge is no longer safe.
choices.why: 官員說橋是安全的。
雨只是改期的原因。

choices.t: Traffic in the tunnel has increased.
choices.why: 隧道只是替代道路。

q.t: Look at the graphic. When will Harbor Bridge be fully closed?
q.zh: 請看圖表。Harbor 大橋何時會全面封閉？

choices.why: 正解：圖表顯示週三全封閉，獨白將時間從十點改為十一點。
十點是圖表上的舊時間。
週四是週二兩線道工程改期的日子。
週二工程已改到週四，且不是全封閉。

q.t: What does the reporter mean when she says, "The mayor said she is sorry for the trouble, but the repairs cannot wait any longer."?
q.zh: 記者說「The mayor said she is sorry for the trouble, but the repairs cannot wait any longer.」是什麼意思？

choices.t: The work will go ahead as planned.
choices.why: 正解：道歉但不能再拖，表示會如期施工。

choices.t: The mayor will cancel the project.
choices.why: 與不能再拖相反。

choices.t: The mayor blames drivers for the damage.
choices.zh: 市長責怪駕駛人造成損壞。
choices.why: 沒有提到責怪。

choices.t: The repair schedule will become longer.
choices.why: 沒有說要延長工期。

items.tag: 地鐵月票價格更正廣告

level.why: 先說傳單原價再更正為新價，需結合圖表與學生折扣計算

script.t: Tired of buying a ticket every time you ride the subway?
script.zh: 厭倦了每次搭地鐵都要買票嗎？

script.t: Metro Link now offers monthly passes at its Eastgate Station service center.
script.zh: Metro Link 現在在東門站服務中心提供月票。

script.t: Last month's flyer said the Standard Pass costs sixty dollars, but that price has dropped.
script.zh: 上個月的傳單說標準票要價六十美元，但價格已經調降。

script.t: Starting this Monday, the Standard Pass is only fifty-two dollars.
script.zh: 從本週一開始，標準票只要五十二美元。

script.t: With it, you can ride as often as you like on every subway line, including the Airport Line.
script.zh: 有了它，你可以不限次數搭乘所有地鐵路線，包括機場線。

script.t: If you also need the buses, choose the Plus Pass for seventy-five dollars.
script.zh: 如果你還需要搭公車，請選擇七十五美元的加強票。

script.t: Students can get either pass at half price with a valid school card.
script.zh: 學生只要出示有效學生證，任一種月票都可享半價。

script.t: Be sure to validate your pass at the turnstile each morning.
script.zh: 請記得每天早上在閘機處驗證你的月票。

script.t: Passes are sold at the service center, which opens at six a.m. on weekdays.
script.zh: 月票在服務中心販售，服務中心平日早上六點開門。

script.t: Please note that the center is closed on public holidays.
script.zh: 請注意，服務中心在國定假日不營業。

script.t: For the first hundred customers this week, we are giving away a free travel mug.
script.zh: 本週前一百位客戶，我們將贈送免費的旅行馬克杯。

script.t: So visit Eastgate Station today, and make your daily trip easier with Metro Link!
script.zh: 今天就來東門站，讓 Metro Link 讓你每天的通勤更輕鬆吧！

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much will a student with a valid school card pay for the pass that covers only the subway?
q.zh: 請看圖表。持有效學生證的學生，購買只涵蓋地鐵的月票要付多少錢？

choices.why: 標準票新價為52美元，學生半價為26美元。
以傳單舊價60美元計算半價，未採用更正後價格。
這是標準票原價，漏掉學生半價。
這是加強票的學生價，並非只涵蓋地鐵的票。

q.t: What can be inferred about the Eastgate service center?
q.zh: 關於東門站服務中心，可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It does not sell passes on public holidays.
choices.why: 服務中心國定假日不營業，故無法購票。

choices.t: It is open around the clock.
choices.why: 平日早上六點才開門，並非全天營業。

choices.t: It sells passes only to students.
choices.why: 學生只是享有折扣，其他人也能購買。

choices.t: It will soon move to the Airport Line.
choices.why: 機場線只是路線名稱，未提及搬遷。

q.t: What will the first hundred customers receive this week?
q.zh: 本週前一百位客戶會得到什麼？

choices.why: travel mug 即旅行杯。
半價是學生的一般優惠，與前一百位無關。

choices.t: A free ride on the Airport Line
choices.why: 機場線只是被提及的路線。

choices.t: A discount on the Plus Pass
choices.why: 加強票價格為75美元，未提到折扣贈品。

level.why: 廣告價格、優惠對象與網站動作直接提到。

script.t: Skip the traffic and see the city on two wheels with CityRide Bike Rental!
script.zh: 避開塞車，騎著兩輪車，用 CityRide 單車租借遊覽城市！

script.t: Our shop is across from Central Station, just a two-minute walk from the exit.
script.zh: 我們的店就在中央車站對面，從出口走路只要兩分鐘。

script.t: A one-hour rental costs only four dollars, and a full day costs fifteen.
script.zh: 租一小時只要四美元，租一整天十五美元。

script.t: Every rental includes a helmet and a lock.
script.zh: 每次租借都附安全帽和車鎖。

script.t: This month, students get a free hour when they show their school card.
script.zh: 本月學生出示學生證可多送一小時免費。

script.t: We are open every day from eight a.m. to seven p.m., even on holidays.
script.zh: 我們每天上午八點到晚上七點營業，連假日也不休息。

script.t: Visit cityride.com to reserve a bike online and skip the line.
script.zh: 請上 cityride.com 線上預約單車，免排隊。

script.t: CityRide: the fun, fast way to get around town!
script.zh: CityRide：好玩又快速的市區代步方式！

q.t: What is being advertised?
q.zh: 廣告的是什麼？

choices.why: 正解：CityRide Bike Rental。
沒有提到計程車。
安全帽只是租借附贈品。
車站只是店面位置的參照點。

q.t: Who gets a free hour this month?
q.zh: 本月誰可以獲得免費一小時？

choices.t: Students who show a school card
choices.why: 正解：students get a free hour when they show their school card。

choices.t: Anyone who rents for a full day
choices.why: 整天租借沒有免費一小時。
線上預約只是免排隊。
假日營業只是營業時間說明。

q.t: What does the speaker suggest listeners do on the website?
q.zh: 說話者建議聽眾在網站上做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：reserve a bike online。
安全帽已包含在租借中。
沒有提到火車時刻。
學生證只是優惠條件。

items.tag: 車站失物招領電話留言

level.why: 電話留言含轉折，需推論失物尚待確認及要求攜帶物品。

speakers.role: 車站失物招領處職員 Carlos

script.t: Ms. Evans, this is Carlos from the Lakeside Station lost-and-found, and I have good news about your backpack.
script.zh: Evans 小姐，我是 Lakeside 車站失物招領處的 Carlos，有關於您背包的好消息。

script.t: A cleaner found a gray backpack on the 8:20 train yesterday.
script.zh: 昨天一位清潔人員在八點二十分的列車上發現一個灰色背包。

script.t: It matches your description, but we have not opened it yet.
script.zh: 它符合您的描述，不過我們還沒有打開。

script.t: Before we return it, we need you to tell us what is inside.
script.zh: 在歸還前，我們需要您告訴我們裡面有什麼。

script.t: Our office is open weekdays from ten a.m. to six p.m., and Saturdays until two.
script.zh: 我們辦公室平日上午十點到下午六點開放，週六開到兩點。

script.t: However, the office will be closed this Monday for a holiday.
script.zh: 不過，本週一辦公室因假日休息。

script.t: Please bring a photo ID when you come to pick it up.
script.zh: 來領取時請帶附照片的證件。

script.t: If you cannot come in person, a family member can collect it with a signed note.
script.zh: 如果您無法親自前來，家人可憑簽名字條代領。

script.t: You can reach me at 555-0165, and thank you for your patience.
script.zh: 您可以撥 555-0165 找我，感謝您的耐心。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 正解：Lakeside Station lost-and-found。
清潔人員是發現背包的人。
沒有提到售票。
沒有提到警方。

q.t: What can be inferred about the backpack?
q.zh: 關於背包可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: Ms. Evans may need to prove it is hers.
choices.zh: Evans 小姐可能需要證明它是她的。
choices.why: 正解：尚未打開，要她說明裡面的東西。

choices.t: It was found at her home.
choices.why: 是在列車上找到的。

choices.t: It has already been returned to her.
choices.why: 還沒有歸還。

choices.t: It is being sent to her by mail.
choices.why: 沒有提到郵寄。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Ms. Evans to bring?
q.zh: 說話者請 Evans 小姐帶什麼？

choices.why: 正解：photo ID。

choices.t: A note signed by the station
choices.why: 簽名字條是家人代領時才需要。

choices.t: A list of her train tickets
choices.why: 沒有提到車票。
照片證件指的是身分證件。

items.tag: 停車許可證區域更正留言

level.why: 先說B區涵蓋再更正為C區，需對照圖表原價與新價

script.t: Hi, Mr. Brennan, Julia here from the Cityview Parking Office, calling back about your permit.
script.zh: 嗨，布倫南先生，我是市景停車管理處的茱莉，回電談您的停車許可證。

script.t: You asked whether you could park on Harper Street with a Zone B permit.
script.zh: 您問過能不能憑B區許可證停在哈珀街。

script.t: When we spoke on Monday, I told you Zone B covers every block of Harper Street.
script.zh: 我們週一通話時，我告訴您B區涵蓋哈珀街每一段。

script.t: I checked the map again, and I need to correct that.
script.zh: 我又查了一次地圖，這點需要更正。

script.t: Zone B ends at Ninth Street, so your office at 1250 Harper Street falls under Zone C.
script.zh: B區在第九街結束，所以您位於哈珀街1250號的辦公室屬於C區。

script.t: That means you will need a Zone C permit, which now costs ninety dollars for six months.
script.zh: 這表示您需要C區許可證，現在六個月九十美元。

script.t: The good news is that Zone C also lets you park near the library and the post office.
script.zh: 好消息是，C區許可證也能讓您停在圖書館和郵局附近。

script.t: To apply, you must bring your vehicle registration and a recent utility bill.
script.zh: 申請時必須帶車輛登記證和近期的水電費帳單。

script.t: You can submit them online or visit our counter, which is open until five thirty on weekdays.
script.zh: 您可以線上提交，或到我們的櫃檯辦理，櫃檯平日開到五點半。

script.t: If you park without the right permit, you could receive a citation of fifty dollars.
script.zh: 如果沒有適當的許可證就停車，可能會收到五十美元的罰單。

script.t: So please don't use your Zone B sticker on Harper Street in the meantime.
script.zh: 所以在此期間，請不要在哈珀街使用您的B區貼紙。

script.t: Call me back at 555-0142 if you have any questions, and thanks again.
script.zh: 如有任何問題，請撥555-0142回電給我，再次謝謝您。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 她自稱來自 Cityview Parking Office，並處理許可證事宜。
罰單只是被提及，她並未表示自己是警察。
圖書館只是C區附近的地點。
辦公室是布倫南先生的，不是說話者的。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much less than the printed price will Mr. Brennan pay for the permit he needs?
q.zh: 請看圖表。布倫南先生需要的許可證，實際價格比印刷價格便宜多少？

choices.why: 他需要C區，印刷價100美元，現價90美元，差10美元。
這是B區印刷價與C區現價的差額，選錯區域。
這是A區印刷價與C區現價的差額，選錯區域。
50美元是罰單金額，與許可證價格無關。

q.t: What must Mr. Brennan provide in order to apply?
q.zh: 布倫南先生申請時必須提供什麼？

choices.t: Proof of car ownership and a recent bill
choices.why: vehicle registration 與 utility bill 的同義替換。
獨白未提到需要雇主信函。

choices.t: A photo of his Zone B sticker
choices.why: 說話者要他別再使用B區貼紙，並非申請文件。
50美元是罰單，申請費為90美元。

level.why: 導覽含迷思更正與行程安排，需理解意圖與後續路線。

script.t: Please step this way, everyone, and stay behind the yellow line as we begin our tour of Union Station.
script.zh: 各位請往這邊走，並站在黃線後面，我們的聯合車站導覽就要開始了。

script.t: This building opened in 1925, but it was completely renovated two years ago.
script.zh: 這棟建築在 1925 年啟用，不過兩年前已全面整修。

script.t: Most people think the main hall's ceiling is painted, but it is actually covered with small glass tiles.
script.zh: 多數人以為大廳的天花板是彩繪的，但其實它覆蓋著小塊玻璃磚。

script.t: Those tiles reflect the daylight, so the hall stays bright without extra lamps.
script.zh: 這些磚片會反射日光，所以大廳不需要額外燈具也很明亮。

script.t: Next, we will walk to the east wing, where the old ticket office has become a small museum.
script.zh: 接下來我們會走到東側廂房，那裡的舊售票處已變成小型博物館。

script.t: Photos are allowed there, but please do not use a flash.
script.zh: 那裡可以拍照，但請不要使用閃光燈。

script.t: After that, we will visit the clock tower, which has a great view of the city.
script.zh: 之後我們會參觀鐘樓，那裡可以欣賞很棒的城市景色。

script.t: Please note that the tower has stairs only, so anyone who cannot climb stairs should tell me now.
script.zh: 請注意鐘樓只有樓梯，所以無法爬樓梯的人現在請告訴我。

script.t: The tour ends at the main entrance at three thirty, and thank you for joining me.
script.zh: 導覽在三點半於正門口結束，感謝各位與我同行。

q.t: What is the main hall's ceiling covered with?
q.zh: 大廳的天花板覆蓋著什麼？

choices.why: 正解：covered with small glass tiles。
那是多數人的誤解。
沒有提到木板。
大廳不需要額外燈具。

q.t: What will the group do after seeing the old ticket office?
q.zh: 參觀舊售票處之後，團體要做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：After that, we will visit the clock tower。

choices.t: Take a break at a cafe
choices.why: 沒有提到咖啡館。
大廳是先前參觀過的地點。
說話者請大家不要使用閃光燈。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "Please note that the tower has stairs only, so anyone who cannot climb stairs should tell me now."?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼說「Please note that the tower has stairs only, so anyone who cannot climb stairs should tell me now.」？

choices.t: To find out whether anyone needs another arrangement
choices.zh: 了解是否有人需要其他安排
choices.why: 正解：請無法爬樓梯的人現在說。

choices.t: To say the tower will close
choices.why: 沒有提到關閉。

choices.t: To warn about a higher ticket price
choices.why: 沒有提到票價。
導覽會在三點半結束。

level.why: 簡短晨會提醒，答案幾乎照字面出現。

script.t: Good morning, team. Before we start loading trucks, I have a quick safety reminder.
script.zh: 各位早安。開始裝貨之前，我有一個簡短的安全提醒。

script.t: Yesterday, a forklift hit a stack of boxes in Aisle 5, and fortunately no one was hurt.
script.zh: 昨天有一台堆高機撞到第五走道的一堆箱子，幸好沒有人受傷。

script.t: From now on, all forklift drivers must slow down to five miles per hour in the aisles.
script.zh: 從現在起，所有堆高機駕駛在走道內必須減速到每小時五英里。

script.t: Everyone on the floor must also wear a yellow safety vest.
script.zh: 在作業區的每個人也都必須穿黃色安全背心。

script.t: You can pick up a vest from the cabinet next to my office.
script.zh: 你們可以到我辦公室旁的櫃子拿背心。

script.t: Next week, we will have a short training session on Wednesday afternoon.
script.zh: 下週三下午我們會有一場簡短的訓練課程。

script.t: That is all for now. Let us have a safe and productive day.
script.zh: 目前就這些。祝大家平安又有成效的一天。

q.t: What is the main topic of the talk?
q.zh: 這段談話的主題是什麼？

choices.why: 裝貨只是開場背景。
正解：減速與穿背心都是安全規定。
撞到的是箱子，但重點是新規定。
沒有提到新員工。

q.t: What are workers required to wear?
q.zh: 工作人員被要求穿戴什麼？

choices.why: 沒有提到安全帽。
沒有提到手套。
正解：yellow safety vest。
沒有提到識別證。

q.t: What will happen next Wednesday?
q.zh: 下週三會發生什麼事？

choices.why: 堆高機是昨天事故的主角。

choices.t: A training session will be held.
choices.why: 正解：we will have a training session → a training session will be held。
第五走道是事故地點。
沒有提到送貨。

items.tag: 工地腳手架拆除時程通知

level.why: 有 however 轉折，含意圖題，需用同義換句理解延期原因

script.t: Attention, everyone at the Riverside Tower construction site, this is a notice from the site office.
script.zh: 注意，河畔大樓工地的所有人員，這是來自工地辦公室的通知。

script.t: We planned to take down the scaffolding on the east side this Thursday.
script.zh: 我們原本計畫本週四拆除東側的鷹架。

script.t: However, the weather report says heavy rain is coming that day.
script.zh: 然而，氣象預報說那天會下大雨。

script.t: Because wet metal can be slippery, the work will move to next Monday.
script.zh: 因為濕的金屬可能很滑，這項工作會改到下週一。

script.t: Until then, please stay away from the area marked with orange tape.
script.zh: 在那之前，請遠離用橘色膠帶標示的區域。

script.t: The concrete team will still start on schedule, but they will work on the west side only.
script.zh: 混凝土小組仍會按時開工，但只會在西側作業。

script.t: Please check the board near the main entrance for your new assignments.
script.zh: 請到主要入口附近的公告板查看您的新任務分配。

script.t: If you cannot find your name, talk to your team leader.
script.zh: 如果找不到您的名字，請找您的組長。

script.t: Thank you, and please be careful out there.
script.zh: 謝謝大家，請多加小心。

q.t: What is the purpose of the announcement?
q.zh: 這則公告的目的是什麼？

choices.t: To report a delay in removing the scaffolding
choices.why: 原定週四，因下雨改到下週一。

choices.t: To introduce a new rule for the concrete team
choices.zh: 介紹混凝土小組的新規定
choices.why: 混凝土小組只是照常開工，並非新規定。

choices.t: To warn about rain damage on the site
choices.why: 下雨只是延期原因，尚未有損害。

choices.t: To ask for new team leaders
choices.why: 組長只是詢問對象，並非公告目的。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "The concrete team will still start on schedule"?
q.zh: 說話者說「The concrete team will still start on schedule」是暗示什麼？

choices.t: Some work will not be affected by the delay.
choices.zh: 部分工作不受延期影響。
choices.why: 混凝土小組照原計畫開工，只限西側。

choices.t: The concrete work has been postponed too.
choices.why: 他說會按時開始。

choices.t: All teams will stop working next week.
choices.zh: 所有小組下週都要停工。
choices.why: 只有東側鷹架拆除延期，並非全面停工。

choices.t: The concrete team will work on the east side.
choices.zh: 混凝土小組將在東側作業。
choices.why: 他們只在西側作業。

q.t: What are workers asked to do about their assignments?
q.zh: 關於工作分配，工人被要求做什麼？

choices.why: 請到主要入口附近的 board 查看。
獨白未提到會打電話。
混凝土小組只是被提到的另一個小組。

choices.t: Stay inside the orange tape area
choices.why: 他要大家遠離橘色膠帶區域。

items.tag: 鋼筋提前進場晨會更正

level.why: 先說下午兩點再更正為十一點，資訊密集，含意圖題與未來行動題

script.t: Alright, let's keep this briefing short, because the steel arrives earlier than expected today.
script.zh: 好，我們把這次簡報縮短，因為鋼材今天比預期提早到。

script.t: Yesterday I told you the rebar would be delivered at two o'clock this afternoon.
script.zh: 昨天我告訴大家鋼筋會在今天下午兩點送到。

script.t: The steel company called, and the truck will actually be here at eleven.
script.zh: 鋼鐵公司來電，卡車實際上十一點就會到。

script.t: That means we need to clear the north yard before then.
script.zh: 這表示我們得在那之前清空北邊的場地。

script.t: Tom's team will move the lumber to the south side, and Priya's team will cover the cement bags with tarps.
script.zh: 湯姆的小組會把木材搬到南側，普莉亞的小組會用防水布蓋住水泥袋。

script.t: I know that sounds like a lot of work, but the forecast shows rain by noon.
script.zh: 我知道這聽起來工作量很大，但預報顯示中午前會下雨。

script.t: If the materials get wet, we will lose at least a day of work.
script.zh: 如果材料淋濕，我們至少會損失一天工時。

script.t: Because the crane is booked for the morning, the steel will be lifted onto the third floor after lunch.
script.zh: 因為起重機早上已被排滿，鋼材會在午餐後吊上三樓。

script.t: Remember, nobody should stand within ten meters of the crane while it is moving.
script.zh: 請記得，起重機移動時，任何人都不應站在十公尺內。

script.t: The safety officer will walk around at ten thirty to check the yard.
script.zh: 安全人員會在十點半巡視場地。

script.t: Please finish your tasks before she arrives, or she may stop the delivery.
script.zh: 請在她到達前完成工作，否則她可能會叫停進貨。

script.t: Okay, that's everything, so let's get to work.
script.zh: 好，就這些，我們開工吧。

q.t: What is the main purpose of the talk?
q.zh: 這段談話的主要目的是什麼？

choices.t: To prepare workers for an earlier steel delivery
choices.zh: 讓工人為提早的鋼材進場做準備
choices.why: 鋼材從下午兩點改為十一點到，需先清場。

choices.t: To explain how to use the crane safely
choices.zh: 說明如何安全使用起重機
choices.why: 起重機安全只是附帶提醒。

choices.t: To announce a day off because of rain
choices.why: 他是要大家搶在下雨前完成工作。

choices.t: To report the results of a safety check
choices.why: 安全人員檢查是之後才進行，尚無結果。

q.t: Why does the speaker say, "I know that sounds like a lot of work"?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼說「I know that sounds like a lot of work」？

choices.t: To admit the tasks are demanding but necessary
choices.zh: 承認任務吃重但有必要
choices.why: 接著說預報顯示中午前下雨，材料淋濕會損失一天。
他仍要大家為進貨做準備。

choices.t: To apologize for giving the wrong time
choices.why: 時間變動是鋼鐵公司造成的，他沒有道歉。

choices.t: To offer extra pay for the work
choices.why: 獨白沒有提到加薪。

q.t: What does the speaker ask the workers to do before the safety officer arrives?
q.zh: 說話者要求工人在安全人員到達前做什麼？

choices.why: finish your tasks 的同義替換。

choices.t: Lift the steel onto the third floor
choices.why: 吊上三樓是午餐後的安排。

choices.t: Move the lumber to the north yard
choices.why: 木材要搬到南側，北側要清空。
打電話的是鋼鐵公司，不是工人。

items.tag: 工地混凝土澆置通知廣播

level.why: 單一主題、句子簡短，答案多半可在原句找到

script.t: Attention, everyone working at the Maple Street building site.
script.zh: 注意，所有在楓樹街工地工作的人員。

script.t: Tomorrow morning, we will pour concrete on the second floor.
script.zh: 明天早上，我們要在二樓澆灌混凝土。

script.t: The trucks will arrive at seven o'clock.
script.zh: 卡車會在七點抵達。

script.t: Please park your cars outside the front fence before then.
script.zh: 請在那之前把車停在前面圍欄外。

script.t: Do not walk under the crane while the work is going on.
script.zh: 施工期間，請不要走在起重機下方。

script.t: The job should be finished by noon.
script.zh: 這項工作預計中午前完成。

script.t: If you have any questions, please see me in the site office.
script.zh: 如有任何問題，請到工地辦公室找我。

script.t: Thank you for your attention.
script.zh: 謝謝大家的注意。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 他對工地人員下達指示，並說可到工地辦公室找他。
卡車只是將抵達的車輛，說話者在對工人說話。
起重機只是被提到，他是在提醒大家別走在下面。
獨白沒有任何擁有大樓的線索。

q.t: Why are workers asked to park outside the fence?
q.zh: 為什麼要求工人把車停在圍欄外？

choices.t: To leave room for the trucks
choices.why: 卡車早上七點要抵達，需先清出場地。
獨白沒有提到天氣或溫度。
中午完工是工作預計時間，與停車無關。
說話者要大家別走在起重機下方。

q.t: When should the job be finished?
q.zh: 這項工作應在何時完成？

choices.why: 原句 finished by noon。
七點是卡車抵達的時間。
獨白沒有提到傍晚。
二樓是施工地點，不是時間。

items.tag: 港口路物流中心擴建新聞

level.why: 先說兩百個職缺再更正為三百，有 however 轉折，含推論題

script.t: Here is your midday business update on Channel 5.
script.zh: 這裡是五台的午間商業快報。

script.t: Port Road Distribution Center has announced a plan to nearly double its size.
script.zh: 港口路物流中心宣布計畫將規模擴大近一倍。

script.t: The company first said the expansion would bring in two hundred jobs, but it has now raised that number to three hundred.
script.zh: 公司起初說擴建會帶來兩百個職缺，但現在已把數字提高到三百個。

script.t: Most of the new workers will load and unload trucks around the clock.
script.zh: 大多數新員工將全天候裝卸卡車。

script.t: Construction is set to begin in April.
script.zh: 工程預定四月開始。

script.t: However, nearby neighbors have asked for quieter work hours.
script.zh: 然而，附近鄰居要求降低施工時段的噪音。

script.t: In response, the company has promised to stop heavy machinery after eight p.m.
script.zh: 對此，公司承諾晚上八點後停止使用重型機具。

script.t: Managers say the larger building will help them handle more online orders.
script.zh: 主管表示，更大的建築能幫助他們處理更多網路訂單。

script.t: Applications will open on the company website next month.
script.zh: 應徵將於下個月在公司網站開放。

script.t: That's all for business, and now back to the studio.
script.zh: 商業新聞就到這裡，現在交還給攝影棚。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 她播報商業快報並交還攝影棚。
經理是被她轉述的對象。
應徵只是她報導的消息。
施工只是新聞內容，她並非工人。

q.t: How many new jobs will the expansion create?
q.zh: 擴建會創造多少新職缺？

choices.why: 更正後的數字是三百。
這是公司起初說的數字，後來已提高。
獨白沒有提到一百。
八是晚上八點的時間。

q.t: What can be inferred about the company's plan?
q.zh: 關於公司的計畫，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: It will change its work habits for the neighbors.
choices.zh: 公司會為了鄰居調整施工做法。
choices.why: 鄰居要求安靜後，公司承諾八點後停用重型機具。

choices.t: The neighbors want the plan canceled.
choices.why: 鄰居只要求較安靜的施工時間。
重型機具八點後停止，全天候的是裝卸工作。
工程預定四月開始。

items.tag: 倉庫假期徵才廣播節目

level.why: 先說網頁夜班時薪再更正，需結合圖表與班次時數計算

script.t: You are listening to Work Week on Radio 640, and I am your host, Dana.
script.zh: 您收聽的是640電台的《工作週》，我是主持人黛娜。

script.t: Today we are talking about holiday jobs at Greenline Logistics, which is hiring two hundred warehouse workers.
script.zh: 今天我們來談綠線物流的假期工作，他們要招募兩百名倉庫人員。

script.t: Every shift runs eight hours, and there are three to choose from.
script.zh: 每個班次八小時，共有三種可選。

script.t: The morning shift starts at six and the evening shift starts at two, as shown on the company's web page.
script.zh: 早班六點開始，晚班兩點開始，公司網頁上也是這樣寫的。

script.t: The page lists the night shift at twenty-four dollars an hour, but that was a mistake.
script.zh: 網頁把夜班列為每小時二十四美元，但那是錯誤。

script.t: The correct rate is twenty-six dollars an hour, because night work is harder to fill.
script.zh: 正確的時薪是二十六美元，因為夜班比較難補人。

script.t: New workers don't need experience, however they must complete a one-day safety class first.
script.zh: 新進人員不需要經驗，不過必須先完成一天的安全課程。

script.t: Classes are held every Tuesday at the Greenline training center.
script.zh: 課程每週二在綠線訓練中心舉行。

script.t: Our guest, hiring manager Paul Reyes, will be joining us after the break.
script.zh: 我們的來賓、招募經理保羅·雷耶斯，將在廣告後加入我們。

script.t: So stay with us, because you can ask him your questions live.
script.zh: 所以請不要走開，您可以現場向他提問。

script.t: This is Work Week, and we'll be right back.
script.zh: 這裡是《工作週》，我們馬上回來。

q.t: Who is Dana?
q.zh: 黛娜是誰？

choices.why: 她自稱是《工作週》的主持人。
招募經理是之後的來賓保羅·雷耶斯。
倉庫工作只是節目主題。
安全課程只是新進人員的要求。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much will a worker earn for one full night shift?
q.zh: 請看圖表。一個完整夜班可以賺多少錢？

choices.why: 正確時薪26美元乘以八小時。
以網頁錯誤時薪24美元計算。
以晚班時薪20美元計算。
這只是時薪，不是整個班次的收入。

q.t: What must new workers do before they start?
q.zh: 新進人員開工前必須做什麼？

choices.why: 原文 complete a one-day safety class。
說話者說不需要經驗。
網頁只是資訊來源，不是要求。
經理只是稍後的節目來賓。

items.tag: 貨運卸貨時間變更留言

level.why: 單一主題、句子簡短，需理解時間改變的原因

script.t: Hello, Mr. Silva, this is Rita from the Eastside Warehouse office.
script.zh: 您好，席爾瓦先生，我是東區倉庫辦公室的麗塔。

script.t: I am calling about your shipment of floor tiles.
script.zh: 我來電是關於您那批地磚的貨運。

script.t: Our dock will be busy at nine, so please come at ten instead.
script.zh: 我們的碼頭九點會很忙，所以請改在十點過來。

script.t: You can use Dock 3 to unload the pallets.
script.zh: 您可以使用三號碼頭卸下棧板。

script.t: Please bring your shipping form with you.
script.zh: 請帶著您的運送單過來。

script.t: I am sorry for the change.
script.zh: 很抱歉有這項更動。

script.t: Please call me at 555-0188 if you cannot make it.
script.zh: 如果您無法準時，請打555-0188給我。

script.t: Thank you, and have a good day.
script.zh: 謝謝您，祝您有美好的一天。

q.t: Who most likely is Mr. Silva?
q.zh: 席爾瓦先生最可能是誰？

choices.why: 他要載貨物到倉庫卸貨並帶運送單。
倉庫職員是說話者麗塔。
磁磚只是貨物，沒有設計相關線索。
電話只是留言方式，並非他的職業。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when she says, "Our dock will be busy at nine"?
q.zh: 說話者說「Our dock will be busy at nine」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She is explaining why the time must change.
choices.zh: 她在解釋為何要改時間。
choices.why: 接著她請對方改十點來。

choices.t: She wants Mr. Silva to arrive at nine.
choices.zh: 她希望席爾瓦先生九點到。
choices.why: 她請他改在十點，不是九點。

choices.t: She is asking him to use Dock 9.
choices.why: 她說的是三號碼頭，九是時間。

choices.t: She plans to close the dock all day.
choices.why: 只有九點忙碌，沒說整天關閉。

q.t: What should Mr. Silva do if he cannot come at ten?
q.zh: 如果席爾瓦先生十點無法到，應該怎麼做？

choices.why: 原句 call me。
三號碼頭是一般卸貨指示，不是無法到時的做法。
帶運送單是一般要求，與無法到達無關。
九點碼頭很忙，所以才改時間。

level.why: 講義行程與口頭更正需對照，有 however 轉折，含圖表題與推論題

script.t: Welcome to the Lakeview Distribution Center, and please stay together as we begin the tour.
script.zh: 歡迎來到湖景物流中心，導覽開始了，請大家保持在一起。

script.t: First, I need everyone to put on a hard hat and safety glasses.
script.zh: 首先，我需要每個人戴上安全帽和護目鏡。

script.t: You can find them on the shelf next to the door.
script.zh: 你們可以在門旁的架子上找到。

script.t: Our first stop is the receiving dock, where trucks drop off new shipments.
script.zh: 第一站是收貨碼頭，卡車會在那裡卸下新到的貨物。

script.t: The schedule in your handout shows a visit to the cold room at 10:40.
script.zh: 你們講義上的行程表顯示10:40要參觀冷藏室。

script.t: However, that room is closed for cleaning today, so we will see the packing area instead.
script.zh: 然而，那個房間今天因清潔而關閉，所以我們改看包裝區。

script.t: Photos are fine in most places, but please do not take pictures of the control room screens.
script.zh: 大部分地方可以拍照，但請不要拍控制室的螢幕。

script.t: Some of the information on them is private.
script.zh: 上面有些資訊是不公開的。

script.t: If you have questions, please raise your hand, and let's get started.
script.zh: 如果有問題，請舉手，我們開始吧。

q.t: What are visitors told to do before the tour?
q.zh: 參觀前，訪客被告知要做什麼？

choices.why: hard hat 和 safety glasses 即防護裝備。
講義只是後面提到的行程資料。
包裝區是之後的行程，不是開始前要做的事。
舉手是有問題時才做。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which area will the group visit at 10:40?
q.zh: 請看圖表。團體在10:40會參觀哪個區域？

choices.why: 冷藏室關閉，改看包裝區。
這是講義上的原定行程，但已關閉。
分揀區是10:20的行程。
控制室是11:00的行程。

q.t: What can be inferred about the control room screens?
q.zh: 關於控制室的螢幕，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: They show information that should not be shared.
choices.zh: 螢幕顯示不該公開的資訊。
choices.why: 禁止拍照，因為上面有些資訊是不公開的。
獨白沒有提到故障。

choices.t: They are in the cold room.
choices.why: 螢幕在控制室。
說話者要求不要拍。

level.why: 先說免運門檻500美元再更正為300美元，含意圖題與推論題

script.t: Got a big job coming up and not enough equipment to finish it on time?
script.zh: 有大工程要開工，設備卻不夠準時完工嗎？

script.t: Ironside Machinery has what you need, from small power tools to full-size excavators.
script.zh: 艾恩賽德機具什麼都有，從小型電動工具到全尺寸挖土機。

script.t: Last month, we told customers that delivery was free for orders over five hundred dollars.
script.zh: 上個月我們告訴客戶，訂單超過五百美元免運費。

script.t: We have since lowered that limit, so now it is free for any order over three hundred dollars.
script.zh: 我們已降低門檻，現在任何超過三百美元的訂單都免運費。

script.t: Better yet, every machine comes with a trained operator at no extra charge on weekdays.
script.zh: 更棒的是，平日每台機器都附贈受過訓練的操作員，不另收費。

script.t: Yes, you heard that right.
script.zh: 沒錯，您沒聽錯。

script.t: On weekends, an operator is available for a small daily fee.
script.zh: 週末則可加購操作員，每天收取少許費用。

script.t: Our equipment is checked every morning, so breakdowns on your site are rare.
script.zh: 我們的設備每天早上都會檢查，所以在您工地故障的情況很少見。

script.t: If something does go wrong, we promise a replacement within three hours.
script.zh: 如果真的出問題，我們保證三小時內更換。

script.t: Visit our yard on Dock Street, or book online anytime.
script.zh: 歡迎到碼頭街的場地，或隨時線上預約。

script.t: Ironside Machinery: we help you build it right.
script.zh: 艾恩賽德機具：幫您把工程做對。

q.t: What is the minimum order for free delivery now?
q.zh: 現在免運費的最低訂單金額是多少？

choices.why: 限額已降到三百美元。
這是上個月的舊門檻。
仍需超過三百美元。
三小時是更換設備的承諾時間。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when he says, "Yes, you heard that right"?
q.zh: 說話者說「Yes, you heard that right」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He wants to stress that the offer is real.
choices.zh: 他想強調這項優惠是真的。
choices.why: 前一句的操作員免費聽起來好得不真實。

choices.t: He is apologizing for an earlier mistake.
choices.why: 先前更正的是運費門檻，並非在道歉。

choices.t: He is asking listeners to repeat an order.
choices.why: 獨白沒有要求重複訂單。

choices.t: He is warning that the offer will end soon.
choices.why: 獨白沒有提到期限。

q.t: What can be inferred about a customer who hires a machine on Saturday?
q.zh: 關於週六租用機器的客戶，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: The customer may pay extra for an operator.
choices.zh: 客戶可能要為操作員額外付費。
choices.why: 週末操作員要收每日費用。

choices.t: The customer cannot get an operator.
choices.why: 週末仍可加購操作員。

choices.t: The customer will receive free repairs.
choices.why: 獨白說的是三小時內更換，沒有免費維修。

choices.t: The customer must visit the yard.
choices.why: 也可以線上預約。

items.tag: 旅館泳池清潔暫停開放廣播

level.why: 單一主題、句子簡短，答案多半照字面出現

script.t: Good evening, guests of the Bayview Hotel.
script.zh: 各位貝景飯店的貴賓，晚安。

script.t: The swimming pool will be closed tomorrow for cleaning.
script.zh: 游泳池明天將因清潔而關閉。

script.t: It will open again on Friday at seven a.m.
script.zh: 週五早上七點會再度開放。

script.t: If you want to swim, you can use the pool at our sister hotel across the street.
script.zh: 如果您想游泳，可以使用對面姊妹飯店的游泳池。

script.t: Just show your room key at the front door of that hotel.
script.zh: 只要在那間飯店的大門出示您的房卡即可。

script.t: The gym on the second floor is open all day.
script.zh: 二樓的健身房全天開放。

script.t: Please ask the front desk if you need more towels.
script.zh: 如果需要更多毛巾，請詢問櫃檯。

script.t: Thank you, and enjoy your stay.
script.zh: 謝謝大家，祝您住宿愉快。

q.t: What is the announcement mainly about?
q.zh: 這則廣播主要是關於什麼？

choices.why: 說明游泳池明天因清潔關閉。
健身房只是附帶提到，且全天開放。
獨白沒有提到換房。
毛巾只是可向櫃檯索取。

q.t: When will the pool open again?
q.zh: 游泳池何時再開放？

choices.why: Friday at seven a.m.
明天是關閉的日子。
是早上七點，不是晚上。
七點是對的，但日期是週五。

q.t: What should guests do if they want to use the other pool?
q.zh: 客人若想使用另一個游泳池，應該怎麼做？

choices.why: Just show your room key。
毛巾是另一項服務，與使用泳池無關。
二樓是健身房。
他們可以今天就去對面使用游泳池。

items.tag: 旅館設施導覽與營業時間更正

level.why: 有 however 轉折，需對照圖表營業時間與口頭更正，含推論題

script.t: Welcome to the Harborview Hotel, and thank you for joining our morning tour of the property.
script.zh: 歡迎來到港景飯店，感謝大家參加我們的早晨館內導覽。

script.t: We will start here at the front desk, where our concierge can help with maps and tickets.
script.zh: 我們從這裡的櫃檯開始，禮賓人員可以協助地圖和票券。

script.t: On the third floor, you will find our spa, which normally closes at eight p.m.
script.zh: 三樓是我們的水療中心，平常晚上八點關門。

script.t: However, it will close at five o'clock today because of a private wedding party.
script.zh: 然而，今天因為有私人婚宴，會在五點關門。

script.t: The business center on the second floor is open until six, and printing is free for guests.
script.zh: 二樓的商務中心開到六點，住客列印免費。

script.t: If you prefer fresh air, the rooftop bar on the twelfth floor opens at five and has a great city view.
script.zh: 如果您想吹吹風，十二樓的頂樓酒吧五點開放，有很棒的城市景觀。

script.t: Please note that guests must be twenty-one or older to enter the bar.
script.zh: 請注意，賓客必須年滿二十一歲才能進入酒吧。

script.t: Breakfast is available every morning on the first floor, but it ends at ten, so please don't be late.
script.zh: 每天早上一樓都有早餐，但十點結束，所以請別太晚。

script.t: That brings us to the end of our tour, so please feel free to ask me any questions.
script.zh: 導覽到此結束，歡迎隨時向我提問。

script.t: Hello, Mr. Okafor. This is Linda Park, the events coordinator at the Maple Grand Hotel.
script.zh: 歐卡佛先生您好，我是 Maple Grand 飯店的活動協調人 Linda Park。

script.t: I am calling about the sales conference you reserved for next Thursday.
script.zh: 我來電是關於您預訂下週四的業務會議。

script.t: When we spoke last month, I told you that the Crystal Ballroom would be available.
script.zh: 上個月我們談話時，我告訴過您水晶廳可以使用。

script.t: Unfortunately, that room has been double-booked, and I apologize for the error.

script.t: I have looked at the other options, and I think the best choice is the room that seats a hundred and twenty on the second floor.
script.zh: 我查看過其他選項，我認為最好的選擇是二樓可容納一百二十人的廳。

script.t: I know you expect about a hundred guests, so that should be plenty of space.
script.zh: 我知道您預計大約一百位賓客，所以空間應該綽綽有餘。

script.t: It has the projector and microphones you requested.
script.zh: 它有您要求的投影機和麥克風。

script.t: The rate is the same as we quoted, so there will not be any extra cost to you.
script.zh: 費用和我們報價的一樣，所以您不需要額外付費。

script.t: Could you let me know by Monday whether this works for you?

script.t: If not, I can also offer you a smaller room with a free lunch for all attendees.
script.zh: 如果不行，我也可以提供較小的廳，並免費提供所有與會者午餐。

script.t: You can reach me at extension 310 or by email. Thank you for your understanding.

麥克風由飯店提供。

items.tag: 智慧溫控器免費提供方案新聞

script.t: Turning now to news about your home, Brightline Power has announced a program to cut electric bills.
script.zh: 現在來看與您家有關的新聞，光線電力宣布了一項降低電費的方案。

script.t: Starting next month, the company will give away free smart thermostats to one hundred thousand households.
script.zh: 從下個月開始，公司將免費送出十萬個智慧溫控器給家庭。

script.t: The company first said only customers in older buildings could join, but it has now opened the program to everyone.
script.zh: 公司起初說只有舊大樓的客戶可以參加，但現在已開放給所有人。

script.t: A thermostat can lower heating and cooling costs by about ten percent, according to the company.
script.zh: 根據公司說法，溫控器可降低約百分之十的冷暖氣費用。

script.t: However, customers must apply online before the end of June to receive one.
script.zh: 然而，客戶必須在六月底前線上申請才能領取。

script.t: Installation is free, and a technician will visit within two weeks.
script.zh: 安裝免費，技師會在兩週內到府。

script.t: Some people worry that the devices are hard to use.
script.zh: 有些人擔心這些裝置很難操作。

script.t: In response, Brightline says its staff will show each customer how to set the schedule.

items.tag: 客房清潔團隊週末客滿會議

script.t: Okay, housekeeping team, let's gather round, because we have a very busy weekend ahead.
script.zh: 好，客房清潔團隊，大家聚過來，因為我們有個非常忙碌的週末。

script.t: Earlier this week, I told you that we expect two hundred guests on Saturday.
script.zh: 本週稍早我告訴過大家，週六預計有兩百位房客。

script.t: The front office just updated that number, and it is now two hundred and sixty.
script.zh: 櫃檯剛更新了數字，現在是兩百六十位。

script.t: The increase comes from a large tour group that arrives on Saturday afternoon.
script.zh: 增加的原因是有一個大型旅行團會在週六下午抵達。

script.t: That means every room must be ready by two o'clock, not four, as usual.
script.zh: 這表示每間房必須在兩點前準備好，而不是像往常的四點。

script.t: I know that is a tight schedule, but I trust you to manage it.
script.zh: 我知道時程很緊，但我相信你們能應付。

script.t: To help, I have asked the laundry service to bring extra linens on Friday evening.
script.zh: 為了幫忙，我已請洗衣服務在週五晚上多送一些床單織品。

script.t: Each of you will clean fourteen rooms instead of twelve.
script.zh: 你們每人要清潔十四間房，而不是十二間。

script.t: Floor supervisors will check the rooms before they are marked ready.
script.zh: 樓層主管會在房間被標示為完成前進行檢查。

script.t: Anyone who needs extra supplies should ask Carlos at the supply closet.
script.zh: 需要額外用品的人，請到備品室找卡洛斯。

script.t: If you run into any problems, text me right away.
script.zh: 如果遇到任何問題，請立刻傳訊息給我。

script.t: Thanks for your hard work, and let's make this a great weekend.
script.zh: 謝謝大家的辛勞，讓我們一起度過美好的週末。

items.tag: 換屋頂報價比較廣播節目

level.why: 先說網站報價再更正，需結合圖表與年長者折扣計算，含推論題

script.t: Welcome back to Home Hour on Radio 1060, where we help you take care of the place you live in.
script.zh: 歡迎回到1060電台的《居家時間》，我們幫您照顧您居住的地方。

script.t: Today's topic is replacing an old roof before the rainy season.
script.zh: 今天的主題是在雨季前更換舊屋頂。

script.t: I have been looking at quotes from three local companies, and the details are shown on our website.
script.zh: 我一直在看三家本地公司的報價，詳細內容在我們網站上。

script.t: The website lists Pinnacle Roofing at sixty-five hundred dollars for an asphalt roof.
script.zh: 網站上列出尖峰屋頂公司的瀝青屋頂報價是六千五百美元。

script.t: However, Pinnacle called this morning to say that the price is now seventy-two hundred because of higher material costs.
script.zh: 然而，尖峰今早來電表示，因材料成本上漲，價格現在是七千兩百美元。

script.t: Their offer for homeowners over sixty-five is ten percent off the new price.
script.zh: 他們給六十五歲以上屋主的優惠是新價格打九折。

script.t: Summit Roofing is the most expensive of the three, but its metal roofs can last fifty years.
script.zh: 高峰屋頂公司是三家中最貴的，但它的金屬屋頂可以用五十年。

script.t: Coastal Roofing has the lowest price, but it cannot start work until July.
script.zh: 海岸屋頂公司價格最低，但要到七月才能開工。

script.t: Whichever company you pick, ask for a written contract before the work begins.
script.zh: 不論選哪一家，開工前請要求書面合約。

script.t: It is also smart to take photos of the roof before and after the job.
script.zh: 在工作前後替屋頂拍照也是明智之舉。

script.t: Next week, we will talk about fixing damp walls, so send me your questions through our website.
script.zh: 下週我們要談如何處理潮濕的牆面，請透過網站把問題寄給我。

script.t: This is Home Hour, and we'll be right back after these messages.
script.zh: 這裡是《居家時間》，廣告後馬上回來。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much will a 70-year-old homeowner pay for a roof from Pinnacle?
q.zh: 請看圖表。一位70歲的屋主向尖峰公司購買屋頂要付多少錢？

choices.why: 新價格7,200美元打九折。
以網站舊價6,500美元打九折計算。
這是新價格，漏掉年長者九折。
這是網站上的舊報價。

q.t: How long can Summit Roofing's metal roofs last?
q.zh: 高峰屋頂公司的金屬屋頂可以用多久？

choices.why: can last fifty years。
十是年長者折扣的百分比。
六十五是享折扣的年齡門檻。
七月是海岸公司最早的開工月份。

q.t: What can be inferred about Coastal Roofing?
q.zh: 關於海岸屋頂公司，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: It may not suit someone who needs a fast repair.
choices.zh: 它可能不適合需要快速修繕的人。
choices.why: 最便宜，但要到七月才能開工。
金屬屋頂是高峰公司的產品。

choices.t: It is more expensive than Summit.
choices.why: 海岸價格最低。

choices.t: It is the best company for older homeowners.
choices.zh: 它是最適合年長屋主的公司。
choices.why: 年長者折扣是尖峰公司的優惠。

level.why: 單一主題、句子簡短，答案多半照字面出現

script.t: Good afternoon, visitors to Greenhill Park.
script.zh: 各位綠丘公園的遊客，午安。

script.t: The picnic area near the lake is closed today.
script.zh: 湖邊的野餐區今天關閉。

script.t: Workers are cutting the grass and fixing the tables.
script.zh: 工人正在割草並修理桌子。

script.t: It will open again tomorrow at nine a.m.
script.zh: 明天早上九點會再度開放。

script.t: You can still have lunch at the tables by the playground.
script.zh: 您仍可在遊戲場旁的桌子用午餐。

script.t: Please keep your dog on a leash everywhere in the park.
script.zh: 請在公園各處讓您的狗繫上牽繩。

script.t: Thank you for your patience, and enjoy your visit.
script.zh: 謝謝您的耐心，祝您遊園愉快。

q.t: What is the announcement mainly about?
q.zh: 這則廣播主要是關於什麼？

choices.why: 野餐區今天因工作而關閉。
狗只是被要求繫牽繩。
遊戲場只是替代用餐地點。
獨白沒有提到清潔湖泊。

q.t: When will the picnic area open again?
q.zh: 野餐區何時再開放？

choices.why: 原文 tomorrow at nine a.m.。
今天仍關閉。
時間是早上九點。
明天就會開放。

q.t: What are visitors asked to do?
q.zh: 遊客被要求做什麼？

choices.t: Keep their dogs on a leash
choices.why: Please keep your dog on a leash。
割草是工人的工作。
獨白沒有要求離園。
湖邊的野餐區今天關閉。

level.why: 導覽詞含規定與下雨備案，需推論。

script.t: Welcome to Willow Park Botanical Garden. My name is Grace, and I will be your guide this morning.
script.zh: 歡迎來到 Willow Park 植物園。我是 Grace，今天早上由我擔任您的導覽員。

script.t: Our tour will last about ninety minutes, and we will walk about two kilometers in total.
script.zh: 導覽約九十分鐘，我們總共會走約兩公里。

script.t: We will begin in the rose garden, which is at its best in early summer.
script.zh: 我們將從玫瑰園開始，初夏是它最美的時候。

script.t: After that, we will visit the greenhouse, where you can see plants from tropical regions.
script.zh: 之後我們會參觀溫室，在那裡可以看到熱帶地區的植物。

script.t: Please stay on the paths and do not touch the plants, since some of them are very delicate.
script.zh: 請留在步道上，也不要碰觸植物，因為有些非常脆弱。

script.t: Photography is welcome, but flash is not allowed inside the greenhouse.
script.zh: 歡迎拍照，但溫室內不可使用閃光燈。

script.t: At the end, we will stop at the gift shop, which offers a ten percent discount to tour participants.
script.zh: 最後我們會在紀念品店停留，參加導覽的人可享九折優惠。

script.t: If it starts to rain, we will continue the tour inside the greenhouse and skip the lake.
script.zh: 如果開始下雨，我們會在溫室內繼續導覽，並略過湖區。

script.t: Now, if everyone is ready, please follow me.
script.zh: 現在，如果大家都準備好了，請跟我來。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 紀念品店只是行程最後一站。
只是說明可以拍照。
正解：I will be your guide → 園區的導覽人員。
沒有提到研究身分。

q.t: What is not allowed inside the greenhouse?
q.zh: 溫室內不允許什麼？

choices.why: 歡迎拍照。
正解：flash is not allowed → using a camera flash。
要求留在步道上。
沒有禁止發問。

q.t: What will happen if it rains?
q.zh: 如果下雨會怎樣？

choices.why: 導覽會在溫室內繼續。
沒有提到關閉。
折扣是導覽的固定優惠。

choices.t: Part of the tour will be skipped.
choices.why: 正解：skip the lake → part of the tour will be skipped。

script.t: Good morning, hikers and campers, and welcome to the Outdoor Report on Radio 88.
script.zh: 早安，健行者與露營者，歡迎收聽88電台的《戶外報告》。

script.t: Today will be sunny and warm, with a high of twenty-eight degrees.
script.zh: 今天晴朗溫暖，最高溫二十八度。

script.t: It is a great day for a walk on Eagle Mountain Trail.
script.zh: 今天很適合走鷹山步道。

script.t: However, strong winds are expected after three in the afternoon.
script.zh: 然而，預計下午三點後會有強風。

script.t: If you plan to stay late, bring a warm jacket.
script.zh: 如果您打算待到晚一點，請帶一件保暖外套。

script.t: Tomorrow, rain is coming, so the trail may be wet.
script.zh: 明天會下雨，所以步道可能很濕。

script.t: This has been the Outdoor Report, and have a safe trip.
script.zh: 以上是《戶外報告》，祝您旅途平安。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 他歡迎聽眾收聽《戶外報告》。
他在電台播報，沒有說自己是管理員。
健行者是他的聽眾。
獨白未提到烹飪。

q.t: What is the high temperature today?
q.zh: 今天的最高溫是多少？

choices.why: high of twenty-eight degrees。
與 twenty-eight 發音易混，但數字不同。
88 是電台頻道。
三是強風開始的時間（三點）。

q.t: What can be inferred about the afternoon?
q.zh: 關於下午，可以推論什麼？

choices.why: 有強風，並建議待晚的人帶保暖外套。
下雨是明天的天氣。
獨白沒有說步道關閉。

choices.t: It will be hotter than the morning.
choices.why: 他建議帶外套，並非更熱。

script.t: Do you want a weekend away from the city?
script.zh: 您想遠離城市過個週末嗎？

script.t: Come camp under the stars at Pine Lake Campground!
script.zh: 來松湖露營區，在星空下露營吧！

script.t: Each campsite has a fire pit and a picnic table.
script.zh: 每個營位都有營火坑和野餐桌。

script.t: You can swim in the lake or walk along the forest trail.
script.zh: 您可以在湖裡游泳，或沿著森林步道散步。

script.t: Firewood is free for every guest.
script.zh: 每位客人都可免費取用柴火。

script.t: Book two nights, and the third night is half price.
script.zh: 訂兩晚，第三晚半價。

script.t: Just call 555-0155 or visit our website today.
script.zh: 今天就撥555-0155或瀏覽我們的網站。

script.t: Pine Lake Campground: your weekend starts here!
script.zh: 松湖露營區：您的週末從這裡開始！

q.t: What is being advertised?
q.zh: 這則廣告在宣傳什麼？

choices.why: Pine Lake Campground。
游泳只是露營區的活動之一。
獨白沒有提到賣鞋。
廣告說的是遠離城市的露營。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when she says, "Book two nights, and the third night is half price"?
q.zh: 說話者說「Book two nights, and the third night is half price」是什麼意思？

choices.t: A three-night stay costs less than usual.
choices.why: 第三晚半價。

choices.t: Guests must stay only two nights.
choices.why: 第三晚可以半價住，並非限制兩晚。
是半價，不是免費。
只有第三晚半價。

q.t: How can listeners book a campsite?
q.zh: 聽眾要如何預訂營位？

choices.t: By phone or on the website
choices.why: call or visit our website。
湖只是露營區的景點。
柴火是免費提供的。
獨白沒有提到寫信。
